   125	        # precheck.json cannot name the commit that adds it: it names the code commit, and the head may add only
   126	        # this task's evidence on top (the evidence-only ancestor rule of verdict.sh condition 1)
   127	        if git(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", bound, head).returncode:
   128	            found.append(f"precheck.json head {bound} is neither the head {head} nor its ancestor")
   129	        elif other := [
   130	            p
   131	            for p in listed(root, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", bound, head)
   132	            if not p.startswith((f".orchestration/{t}/", *exempt))
   133	        ]:
   134	            found.append(
   135	                f"precheck.json head {bound[:12]} differs from the head outside .orchestration/{t}/: {', '.join(other)}"
   136	            )
   137	    if token(result_text, "precheck") != sha256(data):
   138	        found.append(
   139	            f"precheck.json sha256 {sha256(data)} is not result.txt's precheck={token(result_text, 'precheck')}"
   140	        )
   141	    return found
   142	
   143	
   144	def policy(root, base, head, t):
   145	    """Return (the policy bytes, its front matter or None, whether the base's dispatched text is the policy)."""
   146	    dispatched = show(root, base, f".orchestration/tasks/{t}.md")
   147	    data = show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/task.md") if dispatched is None else dispatched
   148	    return data, front(data), dispatched is not None
   149	
   150	
   151	def checker(root, data):
   152	    """Return the base checker's violations on the base's dispatched bytes: it hands the text's literals to git (C8 to
   153	    C10) and opens its design path (C6), so a pull request's own text never reaches it (worker review P0 of bcbd6949)."""
   154	    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
   155	        cmd = [*CHECKER_RUN, "--root", root, str(Path(scratch, "task.md"))]
   156	        Path(cmd[-1]).write_bytes(data)
   157	        run = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
   158	    out = run.stdout.splitlines()  # the file is task.md, so C1 compares task_id with `task`; task-id checks <t>
   159	    # only the checker's own verdict line with its exit code counts; a crash also exits 1, with no verdict line
   160	    if (out[:1], run.returncode) not in ((["task.md: OK"], 0), (["task.md: FAIL"], 1)):
   161	        return [("checker", f"no verdict (exit {run.returncode}): {(run.stdout + run.stderr).strip()[-300:]}")]
   162	    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in out[1:] if ln.strip()]
   163	    return [("checker", ln) for ln in lines if not re.fullmatch(r"C1 task_id .* != file task", ln)]
   164	
   165	
   166	def check_task(root, base, head, t, changed, numstat):
   167	    """Return (violations, warnings) for one task, each violation a (rule, detail) pair."""
   168	    copy_path = f".orchestration/{t}/task.md"
   169	    copy = show(root, head, copy_path)
   170	    if (fm := front(copy)) is None:
   171	        return [("front-matter", f"{copy_path} is unreadable or has no front matter mapping")], []
   172	    data, rules, dispatched = policy(root, base, head, t)
   173	    if rules is None:
   174	        return [("front-matter", f"the base's .orchestration/tasks/{t}.md has no front matter mapping")], []
   175	    found, warnings = [], []
   176	    if fm.get("task_id") != t:
   177	        found.append(("task-id", f"the copy's task_id {fm.get('task_id')!r} is not its directory {t}"))
   178	    result = show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/result.txt")
   179	    result_text = result.decode(errors="replace") if result is not None else ""
   180	    if dispatched:
   181	        if data != copy:
   182	            found.append(("task-copy", f"{copy_path} differs from the base's dispatched .orchestration/tasks/{t}.md"))
   183	    else:  # the copy's own policy is provisional: a head file or a result.txt token is a claim, never authentication
   184	        unverifiable = "task copy unverifiable (no dispatched text at base)"
   185	        found += [("task-copy", unverifiable)] if os.environ.get("REGIME_REQUIRE_DISPATCHED") == "1" else []
   186	        warnings += [] if os.environ.get("REGIME_REQUIRE_DISPATCHED") == "1" else [unverifiable]
   187	        warnings.append("checker skipped: the copy is unverifiable, and the base's checker reads only the base's text")
   188	        if result is not None and token(result_text, "task_copy") != sha256(copy):
   189	            found.append(
   190	                ("task-copy", f"sha256 {sha256(copy)} is not result.txt's task_copy={token(result_text, 'task_copy')}")
   191	            )
   192	    found += checker(root, data) if dispatched else []
   193	    exempt = tuple(f".orchestration/{p}/" for p in rules.get("reset_of") or [] if isinstance(p, str))
   194	    bound = precheck(root, head, t, result_text, exempt)
   195	    if bound is None:
   196	        warnings.append("precheck absent")
   197	    found += [("precheck", detail) for detail in bound or []]
   198	    entries = [a for a in rules.get("allowed_files") or [] if isinstance(a, str)]
   199	    found += [
   200	        ("allowed-files", f"{p} is outside allowed_files")
   201	        for p in changed
   202	        if not p.startswith(exempt) and not any(allowed(p, a) for a in entries)
   203	    ]
   204	    exceeded, cap_warnings = caps(data.decode(errors="replace"), numstat)
   205	    found += [("caps", detail) for detail in exceeded]
   206	    return found, warnings + cap_warnings
   207	
   208	
   209	def main(argv=None):
   210	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
   211	    parser.add_argument("--base", required=True, help="the base ref, such as origin/main")
   212	    parser.add_argument("--head", required=True, help="the pull request's head commit")
   213	    parser.add_argument("--root", help="the base checkout (default: the current git toplevel)")
   214	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
   215	    root = args.root or git(".", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").stdout.decode().strip() or "."
   216	    shas = [
   217	        git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", f"{r}^{{commit}}").stdout.decode().strip()
   218	        for r in (args.base, args.head)
   219	    ]
   220	    if not all(shas):
   221	        print(f"regime-ci: cannot resolve --base {args.base} or --head {args.head} in {root}")
   222	        return 2
   223	    base, head = shas
   224	    at = git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()  # the verifier and the checker must be the base's
   225	    if at != base:
   226	        print(
   227	            f"regime-ci: checkout: {root} is at {at[:12]}, not the base {base[:12]}, so the code run would not be the base's"
   228	        )
   229	        return 1
   230	    try:
   231	        changed = listed(root, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", f"{base}...{head}")
   232	        numstat = []
   233	        for row in listed(root, "diff", "--numstat", "--no-renames", f"{base}...{head}"):
   234	            added, deleted, path = row.split("\t", 2)  # a path may hold a tab; a binary file counts 0 lines
   235	            numstat.append((int(added) if added.isdigit() else 0, int(deleted) if deleted.isdigit() else 0, path))
   236	    except GitError as error:
   237	        print(f"regime-ci: {error}")
   238	        return 2
   239	    for path in sorted(set(changed) & set(RUNS)):
   240	        print(
   241	            f"regime-ci: warning: the diff changes {path}; this run executed the base's version, the audit reads the change"
   242	        )
   243	    dirs = sorted({m.group(1) for p in changed if (m := re.match(r"\.orchestration/([^/]+)/", p))})
   244	    targets = [t for t in dirs if show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/task.md") is not None]
   245	    if not targets:
   246	        stray = [p for p in changed if not p.startswith(".orchestration/")]
   247	        if not stray:  # content alone decides: a branch name is the pull request's own claim
   248	            print("regime-ci: no target (records-only)")
   249	            return 0
   250	        print(
   251	            f"regime-ci: no target: {len(stray)} changed path(s) outside .orchestration/ and no task copy, first {stray[0]}"
   252	        )
   253	        return 1
   254	    # Amendment 1: a later copy whose reset_of names an earlier one is the lineage's only target, when both verify
   255	    policies = {t: policy(root, base, head, t) for t in targets}
   256	    exact = {t: policies[t][2] and show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/task.md") == policies[t][0] for t in targets}
   257	    later = {
   258	        p: t
   259	        for t, (_, rules, _) in policies.items()
   260	        for p in (rules or {}).get("reset_of") or []
   261	        if p in policies and p != t and exact[t] and exact[p]  # both head copies equal their base texts
   262	    }
   263	    for p, t in sorted(later.items()):
   264	        print(f"regime-ci: warning: {p}: predecessor copy .orchestration/{p}/task.md (reset_of of {t})")
   265	    targets = [t for t in targets if t not in later]
   266	    failed = False
   267	    for t in targets:
   268	        try:
   269	            found, warnings = check_task(root, base, head, t, changed, numstat)
   270	        except GitError as error:
   271	            found, warnings = [("git", str(error))], []
   272	        for detail in warnings:
   273	            print(f"regime-ci: warning: {t}: {detail}")
   274	        for rule, detail in found:
   275	            print(f"regime-ci: {t}: {rule}: {detail}")
   276	        failed |= bool(found)
   277	    if not failed:
   278	        print(f"regime-ci: ok {len(targets)} task(s)")
   279	    return int(failed)
   280	
   281	
   282	if __name__ == "__main__":
   283	    sys.exit(main())
     1	name: regime
     2	
     3	# The regime job (plan 024 P1-11, redesigned in T133 regime-ci a02): a pull request that carries a task copy is checked
     4	# by the base's scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py against the base's dispatched policy. pull_request_target runs this
     5	# workflow as it is on the base; the pull request's head is fetched as data and is never checked out or executed.
     6	# It is an optional check until the operator adds `regime` to the ruleset's required contexts.
     7	on:
     8	  pull_request_target:
     9	    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    10	
    11	concurrency:
    12	  group: regime-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
    13	  cancel-in-progress: true
    14	
    15	permissions:
    16	  contents: read
    17	
    18	jobs:
    19	  regime:
    20	    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    21	    timeout-minutes: 10
    22	    steps:
    23	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
    24	        with:
    25	          fetch-depth: 0
    26	          # The base branch's tip at run time: the event's recorded base sha can lag the branch (on PR #420 it was the
    27	          # head's fork point, from before this verifier; ci:39185982423:1). The pull request cannot move this branch.
    28	          ref: refs/heads/${{ github.base_ref }}
    29	          persist-credentials: false
    30	      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c18668ad3cf93ea998bef934396af7bb5c839dc7 # v10.2.0
    31	        with:
    32	          enable-cache: false
    33	      - name: Fetch the pull request's head as data
    34	        env:
    35	          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
    36	          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
    37	        run: |
    38	          git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/pull/${PR_NUMBER}/head:refs/regime/pr-head"
    39	          test "$(git rev-parse refs/regime/pr-head)" = "${HEAD_SHA}"
    40	      - name: Check the pull request with the base's verifier
    41	        env:
    42	          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
    43	        run: uv run --no-config --no-project --with pyyaml python -I scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py --base "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --head "${HEAD_SHA}"

     4	import json
     5	import os
     6	import shutil
     7	import subprocess
     8	import tempfile
     9	import unittest
    10	from pathlib import Path
    11	
    12	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

    14	VERIFIER = "scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py"

    16	    shutil.which("uv") or "uv",
    17	    "run",
    18	    "--no-config",
    19	    "--no-project",
    20	    "--with",
    21	    "pyyaml",
    22	    "python",
    23	    "-I",

    25	T = "t1-a01"
    26	RESIDUAL = '"residual: the fixture row is test data for this control"'
    27	ROWS = "".join(
    28	    f"  - control: {name}\n    disposition: {RESIDUAL}\n"
    29	    for name in (
    30	        "the PR edits src/tool.sh",
    31	        "the PR edits tests/unit/test_tool.py",
    32	        f"the evidence under .orchestration/{T}/",
    33	        "task metadata",
    34	        "metadata separators",
    35	        "in-process effects",
    36	        "workflow and interpreter or environment inputs",
    37	        "new or renamed scripts",
    38	        "orchestrator effect merge",
    39	        "orchestrator effect update-branch",
    40	        "orchestrator effect forced worker removal",
    41	    )

    43	TASK = (
    44	    f"---\nformat: 2\ntask_id: {T}\nkind: code\nsecurity: false\nallowed_files:\n  - src/tool.sh\n"
    45	    f"  - tests/unit/test_tool.py\n  - .orchestration/{T}/**\nthreat_table:\n{ROWS}premises: []\n---\n\n# {T}\n\n"
    46	    "## Check\n\nat most 3 changed lines outside `tests/` and `.orchestration/`, 2 under `tests/`.\n"
    47	)
    48	CODE = {"src/tool.sh": "a\nb\nc\n", "tests/unit/test_tool.py": "x = 1\ny = 2\n"}

    53	class RegimeCiTest(unittest.TestCase):
    54	    def setUp(self):
    55	        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "GITHUB_HEAD_REF"}
    56	        self.env = env | GIT_ENV | {"GITHUB_HEAD_REF": "tools/t1"}
    57	
    58	    def git(self, *args):
    59	        cmd = ["git", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", *args]
    60	        return subprocess.run(
    61	            cmd, cwd=self.repo, env=self.env, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
    62	        ).stdout.strip()
    63	
    64	    def commit(self, files, message):
    65	        for rel, text in files.items():  # None deletes the file
    66	            (self.repo / rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    67	            (self.repo / rel).unlink() if text is None else (self.repo / rel).write_text(text)
    68	        self.git("add", "-A")
    69	        self.git("commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", message)
    70	        return self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    71	
    72	    def build(
    73	        self, copy=TASK, dispatched=TASK, code=None, precheck_head=None, precheck_token=None, evidence=True, **more
    74	    ):
    75	        """A base commit (the checker, the dispatched text), then a code commit and an evidence commit on a branch.
    76	
    77	        more: `late` files committed after the code commit precheck.json names, `precheck_doc` as precheck.json's text,
    78	        `task_copy` as result.txt's token, `checker` as the base's checker, `base` as more base files, `branch` as the
    79	        head branch; precheck_head "side" names a commit on another branch. The base also holds the verifier, the
    80	        checkout returns to the base, and the base's verifier runs against the head commit (a02).
    81	        """
    82	        temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    83	        self.addCleanup(temp.cleanup)
    84	        self.repo = Path(temp.name).resolve()
    85	        self.git("init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    86	        base = {CHECKER: more.get("checker") or (ROOT / CHECKER).read_text(), "README": "base\n"} | more.get("base", {})
    87	        base |= {VERIFIER: (ROOT / VERIFIER).read_text()}
    88	        self.commit(base | ({f".orchestration/tasks/{T}.md": dispatched} if dispatched else {}), "base")
    89	        self.git("update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/main", "HEAD")  # the checker's C8 to C10 probe origin/main
    90	        if precheck_head == "side":
    91	            precheck_head = self.commit({"side.txt": "side\n"}, "side")
    92	            self.git("reset", "-q", "--hard", "HEAD~1")
    93	        self.git("switch", "-q", "-c", more.get("branch", "pr"))
    94	        code_head = self.commit(CODE if code is None else code, "code")
    95	        if "late" in more:
    96	            self.commit(more["late"], "a change after the precheck")
    97	        if evidence:
    98	            pre = more.get("precheck_doc") or json.dumps({"head": precheck_head or code_head})
    99	            token = precheck_token or hashlib.sha256(pre.encode()).hexdigest()
   100	            copy_token = more.get("task_copy") or hashlib.sha256(copy.encode()).hexdigest()
   101	            result = f"AGMSG-RESULT v1 task_id={T} precheck={token} task_copy={copy_token}\n"
   102	            files = {f".orchestration/{T}/task.md": copy}
   103	            if precheck_head != "absent":
   104	                files |= {f".orchestration/{T}/precheck.json": pre, f".orchestration/{T}/result.txt": result}
   105	            self.commit(files, "evidence")
   106	        self.head = self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
   107	        self.git("switch", "-q", "main")
   108	        return self.regime()

   110	    def head_commit(self, files, message):
   111	        """Commit on the head branch and return the checkout to the base."""
   112	        self.git("switch", "-q", "pr")
   113	        self.head = self.commit(files, message)
   114	        self.git("switch", "-q", "main")

   116	    def regime(self, head=None, **env):
   117	        cmd = [*UV, str(self.repo / VERIFIER), "--base", "main", "--head", head or self.head, "--root", str(self.repo)]
   118	        return subprocess.run(
   119	            cmd, cwd=self.repo, env=self.env | env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120, check=False
   120	        )

   122	    def test_regime_ci_reads_the_head_as_data_and_runs_the_base_verifier(self):
   123	        # Bot P1 4308651010 and 4308651011 (a02 items 5, 6): the head rewrites the verifier and the checker into programs
   124	        # that pass and leave markers, and forges a dispatched text with a matching result token; the base's policy,
   125	        # verifier and checker still decide, the checkout stays at the base, and no head program runs.
   126	        fake = 'import pathlib\npathlib.Path("head-program-ran").write_text("x")\nprint("{line}")\n'
   127	        scripts = {VERIFIER: fake.format(line="regime-ci: ok 1 task(s)"), CHECKER: fake.format(line="task.md: OK")}
   128	        rows = "".join(f"  - control: the PR edits {path}\n    disposition: {RESIDUAL}\n" for path in scripts)
   129	        policy = TASK.replace("threat_table:\n", "threat_table:\n" + rows).replace("at most 3 ", "at most 999 ")
   130	        policy = policy.replace("  - src/tool.sh\n", "  - src/tool.sh\n" + "".join(f"  - {path}\n" for path in scripts))
   131	        forged = policy.replace("  - src/tool.sh\n", "  - src/tool.sh\n  - stray.sh\n")
   132	        cases = (  # head changes, expected exit, the violation's phrase
   133	            (CODE | scripts, 0, None),
   134	            (CODE | scripts | {"stray.sh": "x\n"}, 1, "allowed-files: stray.sh is outside allowed_files"),
   135	            (CODE | scripts | {"stray.sh": "x\n", f".orchestration/tasks/{T}.md": forged}, 1, "task-copy: "),
   136	        )
   137	        for code, expected, phrase in cases:
   138	            with self.subTest(expected=expected, phrase=phrase):
   139	                copy = forged if f".orchestration/tasks/{T}.md" in code else policy
   140	                result = self.build(copy=copy, dispatched=policy, code=code)
   141	                self.assertEqual(expected, result.returncode, result.stdout + result.stderr)
   142	                self.assertFalse((self.repo / "head-program-ran").exists(), result.stdout)
   143	                self.assertEqual(self.git("rev-parse", "main"), self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD"))
   144	                if phrase:
   145	                    self.assertIn(f"regime-ci: {T}: {phrase}", result.stdout)
   146	                    self.assertIn(f"regime-ci: {T}: allowed-files: stray.sh is outside allowed_files", result.stdout)
   147	
   148	    def test_regime_ci_never_feeds_a_pull_request_s_text_to_the_base_checker(self):
   149	        # Worker review P0 of bcbd6949: the checker's C10 passes a backticked literal of the text to `git grep`, so a
   150	        # literal that is a git option runs a command; the base's checker reads only the base's dispatched text.
   151	        marker = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "pager-ran"
   152	        self.addCleanup(lambda: marker.unlink(missing_ok=True))
   153	        sentence = f'"This names {CHECKER} beside `--open-files-in-pager=touch {marker};:` for the C10 rule."\n'
   154	        hostile = TASK.replace("kind: code", "kind: docs") + sentence
   155	        for dispatched in (None, TASK):
   156	            with self.subTest(dispatched=bool(dispatched)):
   157	                result = self.build(copy=hostile, dispatched=dispatched)
   158	                self.assertFalse(marker.exists(), result.stdout + result.stderr)
   159	                if dispatched:
   160	                    self.assertIn(f"regime-ci: {T}: task-copy: ", result.stdout)
   161	                else:
   162	                    self.assertIn(f"regime-ci: warning: {T}: checker skipped: the copy is unverifiable", result.stdout)
   163	                    self.assertIn(
   164	                        f"regime-ci: warning: {T}: task copy unverifiable (no dispatched text at base)", result.stdout
   165	                    )

   167	    def test_regime_ci_keeps_an_authenticated_predecessor_a_head_only_successor_names(self):
   168	        # Worker review P3: a successor with no dispatched text at the base cannot drop a dispatched task from the check.
   169	        successor = TASK.replace(T, "t1-a02").replace("allowed_files:", f"reset_of: [{T}]\nallowed_files:")
   170	        successor = successor.replace("  - src/tool.sh\n", "  - src/tool.sh\n  - stray.sh\n")
   171	        result = self.build(code=CODE | {"stray.sh": "x\n", ".orchestration/t1-a02/task.md": successor})
   172	        self.assertEqual(1, result.returncode, result.stdout)
   173	        self.assertIn(f"regime-ci: {T}: allowed-files: stray.sh is outside allowed_files", result.stdout)
   174	        # a02 amendment 1: the chain counts only when both copies verify, so a verified successor does not drop an

def policy(root, base, head, t):
    """Return (the policy bytes, its front matter or None, whether the base's dispatched text is the policy)."""
    dispatched = show(root, base, f".orchestration/tasks/{t}.md")
    data = show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/task.md") if dispatched is None else dispatched
    return data, front(data), dispatched is not None


def checker(root, data):
    """Return the base checker's violations on the base's dispatched bytes: it hands the text's literals to git (C8 to
    C10) and opens its design path (C6), so a pull request's own text never reaches it (worker review P0 of bcbd6949)."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
        cmd = [*CHECKER_RUN, "--root", root, str(Path(scratch, "task.md"))]
        Path(cmd[-1]).write_bytes(data)
        run = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    out = run.stdout.splitlines()  # the file is task.md, so C1 compares task_id with `task`; task-id checks <t>
    # only the checker's own verdict line with its exit code counts; a crash also exits 1, with no verdict line
    if (out[:1], run.returncode) not in ((["task.md: OK"], 0), (["task.md: FAIL"], 1)):
        return [("checker", f"no verdict (exit {run.returncode}): {(run.stdout + run.stderr).strip()[-300:]}")]
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in out[1:] if ln.strip()]
    return [("checker", ln) for ln in lines if not re.fullmatch(r"C1 task_id .* != file task", ln)]


def check_task(root, base, head, t, changed, numstat):
    """Return (violations, warnings) for one task, each violation a (rule, detail) pair."""
    copy_path = f".orchestration/{t}/task.md"
    copy = show(root, head, copy_path)
    if (fm := front(copy)) is None:
        return [("front-matter", f"{copy_path} is unreadable or has no front matter mapping")], []
    data, rules, dispatched = policy(root, base, head, t)
    if rules is None:
        return [("front-matter", f"the base's .orchestration/tasks/{t}.md has no front matter mapping")], []
    found, warnings = [], []
    if fm.get("task_id") != t:
        found.append(("task-id", f"the copy's task_id {fm.get('task_id')!r} is not its directory {t}"))
    result = show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/result.txt")
    result_text = result.decode(errors="replace") if result is not None else ""
    if dispatched:
        if data != copy:
            found.append(("task-copy", f"{copy_path} differs from the base's dispatched .orchestration/tasks/{t}.md"))
    else:  # the copy's own policy is provisional: a head file or a result.txt token is a claim, never authentication
        unverifiable = "task copy unverifiable (no dispatched text at base)"
        found += [("task-copy", unverifiable)] if os.environ.get("REGIME_REQUIRE_DISPATCHED") == "1" else []
        warnings += [] if os.environ.get("REGIME_REQUIRE_DISPATCHED") == "1" else [unverifiable]
        warnings.append("checker skipped: the copy is unverifiable, and the base's checker reads only the base's text")
        if result is not None and token(result_text, "task_copy") != sha256(copy):
            found.append(
                ("task-copy", f"sha256 {sha256(copy)} is not result.txt's task_copy={token(result_text, 'task_copy')}")
            )
    found += checker(root, data) if dispatched else []
    exempt = tuple(f".orchestration/{p}/" for p in rules.get("reset_of") or [] if isinstance(p, str))
    bound = precheck(root, head, t, result_text, exempt)
    if bound is None:
        warnings.append("precheck absent")
    found += [("precheck", detail) for detail in bound or []]
    entries = [a for a in rules.get("allowed_files") or [] if isinstance(a, str)]
    found += [
        ("allowed-files", f"{p} is outside allowed_files")
        for p in changed
        if not p.startswith(exempt) and not any(allowed(p, a) for a in entries)
    ]
    exceeded, cap_warnings = caps(data.decode(errors="replace"), numstat)
    found += [("caps", detail) for detail in exceeded]
    return found, warnings + cap_warnings


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--base", required=True, help="the base ref, such as origin/main")
    parser.add_argument("--head", required=True, help="the pull request's head commit")
    parser.add_argument("--root", help="the base checkout (default: the current git toplevel)")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    root = args.root or git(".", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").stdout.decode().strip() or "."
    shas = [
        git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", f"{r}^{{commit}}").stdout.decode().strip()
        for r in (args.base, args.head)
    ]
    if not all(shas):
        print(f"regime-ci: cannot resolve --base {args.base} or --head {args.head} in {root}")
        return 2
    base, head = shas
    at = git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()  # the verifier and the checker must be the base's
    if at != base:
        print(
            f"regime-ci: checkout: {root} is at {at[:12]}, not the base {base[:12]}, so the code run would not be the base's"
        )
        return 1
    try:
        changed = listed(root, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", f"{base}...{head}")
        numstat = []
        for row in listed(root, "diff", "--numstat", "--no-renames", f"{base}...{head}"):
            added, deleted, path = row.split("\t", 2)  # a path may hold a tab; a binary file counts 0 lines
            numstat.append((int(added) if added.isdigit() else 0, int(deleted) if deleted.isdigit() else 0, path))
    except GitError as error:
        print(f"regime-ci: {error}")
        return 2
    for path in sorted(set(changed) & set(RUNS)):
        print(
            f"regime-ci: warning: the diff changes {path}; this run executed the base's version, the audit reads the change"
        )
    dirs = sorted({m.group(1) for p in changed if (m := re.match(r"\.orchestration/([^/]+)/", p))})
    targets = [t for t in dirs if show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/task.md") is not None]
    if not targets:
        stray = [p for p in changed if not p.startswith(".orchestration/")]
        if not stray:  # content alone decides: a branch name is the pull request's own claim
            print("regime-ci: no target (records-only)")
            return 0
        print(
            f"regime-ci: no target: {len(stray)} changed path(s) outside .orchestration/ and no task copy, first {stray[0]}"
        )
        return 1
    # Amendment 1: a later copy whose reset_of names an earlier one is the lineage's only target, when both verify
    policies = {t: policy(root, base, head, t) for t in targets}
    exact = {t: policies[t][2] and show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/task.md") == policies[t][0] for t in targets}
    later = {
        p: t
        for t, (_, rules, _) in policies.items()
        for p in (rules or {}).get("reset_of") or []
        if p in policies and p != t and exact[t] and exact[p]  # both head copies equal their base texts
    }
    for p, t in sorted(later.items()):
        print(f"regime-ci: warning: {p}: predecessor copy .orchestration/{p}/task.md (reset_of of {t})")
    targets = [t for t in targets if t not in later]
    failed = False
    for t in targets:
        try:
            found, warnings = check_task(root, base, head, t, changed, numstat)
        except GitError as error:
            found, warnings = [("git", str(error))], []
        for detail in warnings:
            print(f"regime-ci: warning: {t}: {detail}")
        for rule, detail in found:
            print(f"regime-ci: {t}: {rule}: {detail}")
        failed |= bool(found)
    if not failed:
        print(f"regime-ci: ok {len(targets)} task(s)")
    return int(failed)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
name: regime

# The regime job (plan 024 P1-11, redesigned in T133 regime-ci a02): a pull request that carries a task copy is checked
# by the base's scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py against the base's dispatched policy. pull_request_target runs this
# workflow as it is on the base; the pull request's head is fetched as data and is never checked out or executed.
# It is an optional check until the operator adds `regime` to the ruleset's required contexts.
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

concurrency:
  group: regime-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  regime:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # The base branch's tip at run time: the event's recorded base sha can lag the branch (on PR #420 it was the
          # head's fork point, from before this verifier; ci:39185982423:1). The pull request cannot move this branch.
          ref: refs/heads/${{ github.base_ref }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c18668ad3cf93ea998bef934396af7bb5c839dc7 # v10.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
      - name: Fetch the pull request's head as data
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/pull/${PR_NUMBER}/head:refs/regime/pr-head"
          test "$(git rev-parse refs/regime/pr-head)" = "${HEAD_SHA}"
      - name: Check the pull request with the base's verifier
        env:
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: uv run --no-config --no-project --with pyyaml python -I scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py --base "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --head "${HEAD_SHA}"
"""Exercise regime-ci.py on temporary repositories (a base with the dispatched text, a head with its copy) and regime.yml."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CHECKER = "scripts/orchestrator/task-consistency-check.py"
VERIFIER = "scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py"
UV = [
    shutil.which("uv") or "uv",
    "run",
    "--no-config",
    "--no-project",
    "--with",
    "pyyaml",
    "python",
    "-I",
]  # as regime.yml
T = "t1-a01"
RESIDUAL = '"residual: the fixture row is test data for this control"'
ROWS = "".join(
    f"  - control: {name}\n    disposition: {RESIDUAL}\n"
    for name in (
        "the PR edits src/tool.sh",
        "the PR edits tests/unit/test_tool.py",
        f"the evidence under .orchestration/{T}/",
        "task metadata",
        "metadata separators",
        "in-process effects",
        "workflow and interpreter or environment inputs",
        "new or renamed scripts",
        "orchestrator effect merge",
        "orchestrator effect update-branch",
        "orchestrator effect forced worker removal",
    )
)
TASK = (
    f"---\nformat: 2\ntask_id: {T}\nkind: code\nsecurity: false\nallowed_files:\n  - src/tool.sh\n"
    f"  - tests/unit/test_tool.py\n  - .orchestration/{T}/**\nthreat_table:\n{ROWS}premises: []\n---\n\n# {T}\n\n"
    "## Check\n\nat most 3 changed lines outside `tests/` and `.orchestration/`, 2 under `tests/`.\n"
)
CODE = {"src/tool.sh": "a\nb\nc\n", "tests/unit/test_tool.py": "x = 1\ny = 2\n"}
SKIPPED = f"regime-ci: warning: {T}: checker skipped: the copy is unverifiable, and the base's checker reads only the base's text"
GIT_ENV = {f"GIT_{role}_{k}": v for role in ("AUTHOR", "COMMITTER") for k, v in (("NAME", "t"), ("EMAIL", "t@t"))}


class RegimeCiTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "GITHUB_HEAD_REF"}
        self.env = env | GIT_ENV | {"GITHUB_HEAD_REF": "tools/t1"}

    def git(self, *args):
        cmd = ["git", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", *args]
        return subprocess.run(
            cmd, cwd=self.repo, env=self.env, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
        ).stdout.strip()

    def commit(self, files, message):
        for rel, text in files.items():  # None deletes the file
            (self.repo / rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (self.repo / rel).unlink() if text is None else (self.repo / rel).write_text(text)
        self.git("add", "-A")
        self.git("commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", message)
        return self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD")

    def build(
        self, copy=TASK, dispatched=TASK, code=None, precheck_head=None, precheck_token=None, evidence=True, **more
    ):
        """A base commit (the checker, the dispatched text), then a code commit and an evidence commit on a branch.

        more: `late` files committed after the code commit precheck.json names, `precheck_doc` as precheck.json's text,
        `task_copy` as result.txt's token, `checker` as the base's checker, `base` as more base files, `branch` as the
        head branch; precheck_head "side" names a commit on another branch. The base also holds the verifier, the
        checkout returns to the base, and the base's verifier runs against the head commit (a02).
        """
        temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temp.cleanup)
        self.repo = Path(temp.name).resolve()
        self.git("init", "-q", "-b", "main")
        base = {CHECKER: more.get("checker") or (ROOT / CHECKER).read_text(), "README": "base\n"} | more.get("base", {})
        base |= {VERIFIER: (ROOT / VERIFIER).read_text()}
        self.commit(base | ({f".orchestration/tasks/{T}.md": dispatched} if dispatched else {}), "base")
        self.git("update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/main", "HEAD")  # the checker's C8 to C10 probe origin/main
        if precheck_head == "side":
            precheck_head = self.commit({"side.txt": "side\n"}, "side")
            self.git("reset", "-q", "--hard", "HEAD~1")
        self.git("switch", "-q", "-c", more.get("branch", "pr"))
        code_head = self.commit(CODE if code is None else code, "code")
        if "late" in more:
            self.commit(more["late"], "a change after the precheck")
        if evidence:
            pre = more.get("precheck_doc") or json.dumps({"head": precheck_head or code_head})
            token = precheck_token or hashlib.sha256(pre.encode()).hexdigest()
            copy_token = more.get("task_copy") or hashlib.sha256(copy.encode()).hexdigest()
            result = f"AGMSG-RESULT v1 task_id={T} precheck={token} task_copy={copy_token}\n"
            files = {f".orchestration/{T}/task.md": copy}
            if precheck_head != "absent":
                files |= {f".orchestration/{T}/precheck.json": pre, f".orchestration/{T}/result.txt": result}
            self.commit(files, "evidence")
        self.head = self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
        self.git("switch", "-q", "main")
        return self.regime()

    def head_commit(self, files, message):
        """Commit on the head branch and return the checkout to the base."""
        self.git("switch", "-q", "pr")
        self.head = self.commit(files, message)
        self.git("switch", "-q", "main")

    def regime(self, head=None, **env):
        cmd = [*UV, str(self.repo / VERIFIER), "--base", "main", "--head", head or self.head, "--root", str(self.repo)]
        return subprocess.run(
            cmd, cwd=self.repo, env=self.env | env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120, check=False
        )

    def test_regime_ci_reads_the_head_as_data_and_runs_the_base_verifier(self):
        # Bot P1 4308651010 and 4308651011 (a02 items 5, 6): the head rewrites the verifier and the checker into programs
        # that pass and leave markers, and forges a dispatched text with a matching result token; the base's policy,
        # verifier and checker still decide, the checkout stays at the base, and no head program runs.
        fake = 'import pathlib\npathlib.Path("head-program-ran").write_text("x")\nprint("{line}")\n'
        scripts = {VERIFIER: fake.format(line="regime-ci: ok 1 task(s)"), CHECKER: fake.format(line="task.md: OK")}
        rows = "".join(f"  - control: the PR edits {path}\n    disposition: {RESIDUAL}\n" for path in scripts)
        policy = TASK.replace("threat_table:\n", "threat_table:\n" + rows).replace("at most 3 ", "at most 999 ")
        policy = policy.replace("  - src/tool.sh\n", "  - src/tool.sh\n" + "".join(f"  - {path}\n" for path in scripts))
        forged = policy.replace("  - src/tool.sh\n", "  - src/tool.sh\n  - stray.sh\n")
        cases = (  # head changes, expected exit, the violation's phrase
            (CODE | scripts, 0, None),
            (CODE | scripts | {"stray.sh": "x\n"}, 1, "allowed-files: stray.sh is outside allowed_files"),
            (CODE | scripts | {"stray.sh": "x\n", f".orchestration/tasks/{T}.md": forged}, 1, "task-copy: "),
        )
        for code, expected, phrase in cases:
            with self.subTest(expected=expected, phrase=phrase):
                copy = forged if f".orchestration/tasks/{T}.md" in code else policy
                result = self.build(copy=copy, dispatched=policy, code=code)
                self.assertEqual(expected, result.returncode, result.stdout + result.stderr)
                self.assertFalse((self.repo / "head-program-ran").exists(), result.stdout)
                self.assertEqual(self.git("rev-parse", "main"), self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD"))
                if phrase:
                    self.assertIn(f"regime-ci: {T}: {phrase}", result.stdout)

.orchestration/plans/024-design-quality.md:105:orchestrator 側の仕組み（merge gate、integrate-merge、orch-gate、dispositions、audit-pool、verdict、chain）は、同じホスト上で同じ UID の worker プロセスと共存する。2026-10-19 の C-80 審査（a05、dispositions-a02、audit-pool-a01 の 3 文、計 19 件の P1）は、どの文も同じ前提を書かず同じ穴を持つことを示した。以後、`security: true` の orchestrator 側タスク文は本節を参照で適用し、本節の各項目に対応する threat 行を持つ。文ごとに言い換えない。
.orchestration/plans/024-design-quality.md:107:1. **書き込み境界（前提 6、ランタイム別に正直に）** Claude worker 席は専用の設定ディレクトリ `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-worker`（chezmoi が描画、operator が一度 login）で起動し、orchestrator の `~/.claude` と設定を共有しない。worker 設定：除外コマンド無し、Herdr socket 無し、sandbox の allowWrite は自席 worktree と agmsg store と席別キャッシュだけ、`failIfUnavailable: true`、信頼パス（anchored checkout の `.claude/worktrees/` 以外、`~/.agents`、`~/.claude*`、`~/.local`、`~/.config`）への Edit deny（公式文書：file tool の permission 検査は要求パスと symlink 解決後のパスの両方に deny を適用し、symlink そのものへの書き込みは拒否する）、sandbox の強制範囲はユーザー設定ではなく **managed settings**（`/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、公式文書 "Repository settings under an admin-required sandbox"：project/local 設定は sandbox を無効化したり除外・socket を足したりできない）に置く。chezmoi は user ではこのファイルを書けないので、描画した内容を操作者が `sudo` で一度配置する（操作者手順）。worker 設定は worktree 自身の `.claude/**` と `.mcp.json` への Edit deny（`//<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/*/.claude/**`）を持つ（Bash 側は sandbox 既定の settings/hooks の denyWithinAllow）。agmsg store（全席が書く）から配送 hook が driver や plugin を source する上流の経路（storage.sh の `drivers.partition` traversal、`db/trusted-plugins` と `plugins/partition/shared.sh` による差し替え承認）は別タスク（agmsg hardening）の行で、worker 設定は `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/plugins/**` と `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/db/trusted-plugins` への書き込みを deny し（Edit deny は sandbox の deny にも合流する）、hook 側は store 由来の設定値を検証するまで残余と書く。managed settings の配置先は OS で異なる（macOS `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、Linux `/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json`）。hook は agmsg 配送だけを、hook コマンドを `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<home> …` で始めて（`BASH_ENV` などの継承環境を bash 起動前に消す；PATH 固定だけでは BASH_ENV が先に走る）絶対パスのインタプリタで呼び（上流の agmsg スクリプトは `/usr/bin/env bash` の shebang を持つので、hook 実行環境の PATH が shim を含まないことで束縛する）、各 hook に `onFailure: "block"`。公式文書：linked worktree の session は **main checkout の `.claude/settings.local.json` を読む**ので、worker 向けの hook を worktree の settings.local.json に書いても読まれず、逆に orchestrator の local hooks が worker session でも走る。したがって orchestrator 側の local hooks も guard 経由にし、worker 側の hook は worker config dir の settings に置く。Edit deny の一覧は `git ls-tree` ではなく描画時の静的一覧（manifest に列挙、`.agents/worklog/**` と `.agents/worklog/uv-cache/**` を含む）とし、`~/.agents/**` の全面 deny は agmsg store の書き込みと矛盾するので、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.agents/skills/**/scripts/**`、`~/.agents/model-profiles.env` などストア以外を列挙する。公式文書で確認した事実（2026-10-19）：`Edit(path)` の deny は Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit にも効き、deny → ask → allow の順で最初の一致が決まる；ただし Read/Edit の deny は **Bash sandbox の設定にも合流する**（"Paths and domains from both sandbox settings and permission rules are merged into the final sandbox configuration"）ので、ユーザー設定（全席共有）に `.orchestration/**` の Edit deny を書くと orchestrator の Bash による記録書き込みも止まる。hook は起動時に固定されず、設定ファイルの編集は file watcher が即座に反映する。`sandbox.failIfUnavailable` の既定は fail-open（依存が無ければ sandbox 無しで実行）。したがって Claude 席の境界は Edit deny 規則ではなく、**ユーザーレベルの PreToolUse hook**（`~/.claude/hooks/worker-write-boundary`、chezmoi が描画、`/bin/sh` または絶対パスの `python3 -I`）で作る：cwd の realpath が `<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/` 配下の session では、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit の対象が cwd の外、または `<cwd>/.claude/**`・`<cwd>/.mcp.json` のとき `permissionDecision: deny` を返す。Bash 側は sandbox の既定 `denyWithinAllow`（settings、hooks）と `allowWrite`（自席 worktree）が担う。`failIfUnavailable: true` を全席に置く。 Codex 席は sandbox（workspace-write）がツールの書き込み全部を自席の worktree と列挙パスに限る。Claude 席は Seatbelt sandbox が Bash を限るだけで、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit、hook、MCP プロセスは sandbox 外で動き、permission policy（permgate の決定論ポリシー）が path で拒否しない限り anchored checkout や `~/.agents` にも書ける（2026-10-19 時点、描画済み設定にその deny は無い）。したがって前提 6 は「Codex 席は成立、Claude 席は P1-15 が描画設定に Edit の path deny を入れるまで残余」と書く。P1-15 以前に「worker は信頼ルートに書けない」と書く文は誤りで、C-80 が拒否する。P1-15 が入るまで、承認の出所は項目 8 の「コミット済み台帳」で守る。書き込みは自席の worktree（`.claude/worktrees/<name>`）、scratch、列挙されたツールキャッシュに限る。anchored checkout（`.claude/worktrees/` 以外）、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.claude/hooks`、信頼ルートのバイナリ、orchestrator の証跡・スナップショット・lock は worker から書けない。render テストが描画後の deny を検証する。残余は「どの席 sandbox にも属さない同一 UID プロセス」と、Worker Playbook step 4 が sandbox 外に出す少数のコマンド（gh）。後者は D-024-17（P1-15）で絶対パスの実行体に束縛する。 The protected-path inventory a seat's Edit denies cover is enumerated from the inputs of every trusted executable, not only the executables: it includes `~/.agents/permgate-policy.yaml` (permgate rereads it for every decision), `~/.local/lib/python*/site-packages` and every other user-site or startup-hook location of the interpreters in use (`.pth`, `usercustomize.py`, `sitecustomize.py`), `~/.claude-worker`'s hook and settings files, and the rendered guard; a text that binds an executable names its inputs in the same inventory (P1-15 amendment 5 C-80, 2026-10-19). The inventory of executable configuration sources a worker start screens is the documented loading list of the installed Claude Code version, enumerated once from the documentation (settings: user, project, local and managed `settings.json`; project `.mcp.json`; the configuration directory's global state `.claude.json` with user-scoped and project-local MCP servers; plugins and skills directories (`.claude/skills/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, enabled plugins); hook handlers of every documented type (`command`, `http` and any other `type` value the hooks reference lists: a handler is an executable input whether it names a command or a URL, and a worker start refuses every handler type but `command`), `apiKeyHelper`, `statusLine.command`, MCP server commands), and the launcher screens or disables every source before accepting workspace trust, refusing any executable payload it did not write; adding sources one review at a time is the anti-pattern (P1-15 a02 reviews 2ae9e2c and ebbb71b, 2026-10-19). The enumeration quotes the documentation's values (the page, its fetched_at and the listed values) in the text's premises so a reviewer can check them against the live page; naming a source by one of its fields ("hook commands" for hook handlers) is the same anti-pattern one level down (a02 review b2a186e, 2026-10-19T20:36Z; C-95).
.orchestration/plans/024-design-quality.md:108:2. **無害化した環境を最初に** 最初の処理として `env -i` に入り、PATH は信頼ルートで解決した絶対バイナリへのリンクだけの私設ディレクトリ（shims、空、相対は拒否）。git は毎回 `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.fsmonitor=false -c protocol.allow=never -c protocol.https.allow=always` と明示 `-C`（https だけ許す。`protocol.allow=never` 単独は必要な fetch を止める）。 検査の読み取りは `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1` で部分クローンの遅延 fetch（checkout 設定の credential.helper を起動しうる）を止め、`-c submodule.recurse=false --ignore-submodules=all` で submodule 内の status/diff（submodule 自身の設定が filter を有効化しうる）を止める。`.gitmodules` を持つ checkout は検査対象として拒否する。 `-C` は作業木を束縛しないので（repo-local の `core.worktree` が読み先を checkout 外へ向けられる）、git は `--git-dir=<checkout>/.git --work-tree=<checkout>` を明示し、`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` の realpath が checkout と一致しないときは拒否する。 premise や検査の「コマンド実行」は、固定語彙の読み取り専用プローブ（`git rev-parse <ref>`、`test -e <path>`、`grep -c <pattern> <file>` のように検査器自身が解釈する形）だけを許し、任意のシェル文字列は実行しない（本文のハッシュはコマンド文を認証するだけで、`python -I scripts/x.py` のファイル被演算子や `source ./x.sh` の中身は認証しない）。diff と show は `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv` と `-c core.attributesFile=/dev/null -c core.sshCommand=false` を付け、PR 側の `.gitattributes`（external diff、textconv、filter）が検査内容や実行物を変えないようにする。Python は `-I`。PATH 探索で実行するものは無い。 A shell script that runs under a PR-controlled or worker-controlled environment (verdict.sh, the chain glue, CI steps) is executed as a program with `#!/bin/bash -p`, never as `bash <file>`, and only by a trusted parent that supplies the clean environment before the exec: `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<passwd home> LANG=C.UTF-8 /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -p <absolute script path> …` (long options before `-p`). Privileged mode discards inherited functions, `BASH_ENV`/`ENV`, `SHELLOPTS`, `BASHOPTS`, `CDPATH` and `GLOBIGNORE`, but on Linux an inherited `LD_PRELOAD`/`LD_AUDIT` already executes while the loader maps `/bin/bash`, before `-p` or any statement runs, so a self re-exec inside the script is not a boundary and re-executing `"$0"` would reopen the caller's pathname (a worker-owned symlink can be swapped between the two executions); the program therefore verifies and refuses instead of repairing: its environment must consist of exactly the allowed names (checked through absolute paths `/usr/bin/env`, `/usr/bin/grep`), `$0` resolved with `realpath` must be a regular file under the repository root, and HOME must equal the passwd home of the real uid (`/usr/bin/dscl . -read /Users/<user> NFSHomeDirectory` on macOS, `/usr/bin/getent passwd <uid>` on Linux), otherwise exit 2 with a named message. A caller-set sentinel variable is not a sanitization proof, because the caller controls it (ci-efficiency a04 and verdict a04 C-80 reviews, 2026-10-19). No script accepts a caller-supplied executable directory; interpreters are the fixed absolute paths item 9 names.
.orchestration/plans/024-design-quality.md:109:3. **信頼パスの境界検査** 仕組みが信頼するパス（スクリプト、台帳、証跡、worktree、lock、出力先）は realpath で解決し、`.claude/worktrees/` または manifest の worker ルート配下なら拒否（ask/hold）。symlink 構成要素は解決後に比較し、大小文字を区別しないファイルシステムでは同一性比較を大小文字非依存で行う。 A validator or scanner enumerates its inputs by walking the filesystem under fixed roots (every regular file, ignored or untracked included), never by asking git which files exist: `git ls-files` trusts the index and the working-tree `.gitignore` rules, which a same-UID writer edits without a commit (a07 C-80 rounds 1 to 3, 2026-10-19); git is consulted only to confirm the root (`--show-toplevel` equality with a real `.git` directory) and never as an exclusion authority.
.orchestration/plans/024-design-quality.md:114:8. **承認はコミット済み台帳から読む** permission の決定行（`scope=permission approved_by=user diff_sha256=…`）は anchored checkout の作業コピーではなく、コミット済みの台帳から読む。読み方は `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` が返す commit sha を取り、GitHub API（`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/contents/.orchestration/decisions.tsv?ref=<sha>`、sandbox 内）でその sha の内容を取得する。ローカルの `git show` は共有 object database が書けるため中間 tree の差し替えで偽物を返しうる（第 3 回審査の所見 2）（ローカルの ref 名 `origin/main` は経由しない。`refs/replace/` も書けるので replacement を無効にする。Codex worker は `.git/objects` と `.git/refs` に書けるので ref は差し替えられるが、sha で指した object は内容アドレスで偽造できない）。作業コピーの行は提案で、記録 PR が main にマージされて初めて承認になる（PR の承認は操作者の操作）。偽造には main へのマージが要る。 The same applies to the PR content a mechanism evaluates (the verdict, the audit precheck, the counters): the changeset is read from GitHub at the 40-hex head (`gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/<base40>...<head40>`, `…/contents/<path>?ref=<head40>`) or from a private clone whose object store no worker can write; the main checkout's shared `.git/objects` and its `origin/main` ref are not evidence sources, because Codex workers write them (a04 C-80 round 1, 2026-10-19). Evidence files are named and matched by the full 40-hex head, never by a 7-character prefix. Every `gh` invocation names the repository explicitly: `gh pr`, `gh run` and `gh issue` subcommands take `--repo mryfmo/dotfiles` or the full pull-request URL, and `gh api` (which has no `--repo` flag) takes the explicit `repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/…` endpoint path, never a `{owner}/{repo}` placeholder; a `gh api graphql` call binds the repository through fixed query variables (`owner: "mryfmo"`, `name: "dotfiles"` as constants in the script, passed with `-f`/`-F`) and uses only node ids obtained from a query bound by those variables (verdict a04 C-80 round 5, 2026-10-19): the local repository configuration selects the default repository otherwise, and a matching head sha does not bind the repository because a fork can hold the same commit (verdict a04 C-80 round 2, 2026-10-19). A mechanism whose application path runs code this contract does not yet cover (the agmsg storage layer sourced by `dispatch.sh`/`history.sh`; the integration gate until its own hardening task lands) names that task as the prerequisite of its `--apply` mode and runs shadow-only until the prerequisite is merged. The sha of canonical `main` comes from the fixed repository's API (`gh api repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha`), never from `git ls-remote origin`, whose destination the local remote and URL-rewrite configuration control (P1-12 a04 C-80, 2026-10-19T20:01Z); the content read at that sha comes from `repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/contents/<path>?ref=<sha40>`. Every `gh api` call that decides also binds the host with `--hostname github.com` (`GH_HOST` and the hosts configuration select the API host otherwise), a subcommand binds it through the `github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles` form of `--repo`, and a test that exports a hostile `GH_HOST` shows the call still names github.com or refuses (a02 review b2a186e, 2026-10-19T20:36Z).
.orchestration/plans/024-design-quality.md:115:9. **私設キャッシュ** orchestrator 側の実行は worker と共有するキャッシュ（`~/.cache/uv`、`~/.local/share/uv`、mise）から実行可能物を読まない。`UV_CACHE_DIR` を anchored checkout 配下（`.agents/worklog/uv-cache`、gitignored、worker 書き込み不可）に固定し、`uv run --no-config --no-project --offline --python <信頼ルートの絶対パスのインタプリタ>` で起動する（`--no-config` で uv の設定探索を止め、`--python` の絶対パスで cwd や親の `.venv` の発見を止める；敵対的な `.venv` と `uv.toml` を置いた fixture で検証）。hook は uv を使わず jq と python 標準ライブラリだけで動く。 One trusted interpreter resolver (`scripts/orchestrator/trusted-interpreter.sh`, P1-3 lineage) resolves `<abs>` from the repository's pinned declaration to a regular file under the tool manager's install root (the install root is anchored to the passwd home of the real uid, never to the HOME variable, which a caller can forge), refuses anything else, and every orchestrator-side script consumes it; no script keeps its own `command -v`, `mise which` or PATH fallback (ci-rerun.sh security review 44cb835, 2026-10-19). Shell code of other projects (the agmsg storage layer and its `drivers.partition` sourcing) is never sourced by an orchestrator-side mechanism; counters are read from the agmsg SQLite store read-only with a fixed query or from the pasted record. Every Python child of a trusted entrypoint runs with `-I` (isolated: no user site, no `PYTHON*` environment, no script directory on `sys.path`), so `uv run … python -I <script>` rather than `--script` for a script without declared dependencies; a test plants a `.pth` and a `usercustomize.py` in a fake user site and asserts they never execute (P1-15 amendment 5 C-80, 2026-10-19). A program takes `UV_CACHE_DIR` from the environment the trusted parent supplies and refuses when it is absent or not an absolute path; it never computes a default from its own root. The orchestrator's parent prefix sets the main checkout's `.agents/worklog/uv-cache`; a worker's launcher sets `<worktree>/.uv-cache` (the P1-15 worker launch value: `.agents/` is read-only in the Codex permission profile, so a root-derived `.agents/worklog/uv-cache` cannot be created by a worker; P1-12 a03, 2026-10-19T11:28Z); tests set a temporary directory.

.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-trusted-exec-contract-tests-a01-audit-9545e59.md:2604:   104	2. **無害化した環境を最初に** 最初の処理として `env -i` に入り、PATH は信頼ルートで解決した絶対バイナリへのリンクだけの私設ディレクトリ（shims、空、相対は拒否）。git は毎回 `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.fsmonitor=false -c protocol.allow=never -c protocol.https.allow=always` と明示 `-C`（https だけ許す。`protocol.allow=never` 単独は必要な fetch を止める）。 検査の読み取りは `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1` で部分クローンの遅延 fetch（checkout 設定の credential.helper を起動しうる）を止め、`-c submodule.recurse=false --ignore-submodules=all` で submodule 内の status/diff（submodule 自身の設定が filter を有効化しうる）を止める。`.gitmodules` を持つ checkout は検査対象として拒否する。 `-C` は作業木を束縛しないので（repo-local の `core.worktree` が読み先を checkout 外へ向けられる）、git は `--git-dir=<checkout>/.git --work-tree=<checkout>` を明示し、`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` の realpath が checkout と一致しないときは拒否する。 premise や検査の「コマンド実行」は、固定語彙の読み取り専用プローブ（`git rev-parse <ref>`、`test -e <path>`、`grep -c <pattern> <file>` のように検査器自身が解釈する形）だけを許し、任意のシェル文字列は実行しない（本文のハッシュはコマンド文を認証するだけで、`python -I scripts/x.py` のファイル被演算子や `source ./x.sh` の中身は認証しない）。diff と show は `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv` と `-c core.attributesFile=/dev/null -c core.sshCommand=false` を付け、PR 側の `.gitattributes`（external diff、textconv、filter）が検査内容や実行物を変えないようにする。Python は `-I`。PATH 探索で実行するものは無い。 A shell script that runs under a PR-controlled or worker-controlled environment (verdict.sh, the chain glue, CI steps) is executed as a program with `#!/bin/bash -p`, never as `bash <file>`, and only by a trusted parent that supplies the clean environment before the exec: `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<passwd home> LANG=C.UTF-8 /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -p <absolute script path> …` (long options before `-p`). Privileged mode discards inherited functions, `BASH_ENV`/`ENV`, `SHELLOPTS`, `BASHOPTS`, `CDPATH` and `GLOBIGNORE`, but on Linux an inherited `LD_PRELOAD`/`LD_AUDIT` already executes while the loader maps `/bin/bash`, before `-p` or any statement runs, so a self re-exec inside the script is not a boundary and re-executing `"$0"` would reopen the caller's pathname (a worker-owned symlink can be swapped between the two executions); the program therefore verifies and refuses instead of repairing: its environment must consist of exactly the allowed names (checked through absolute paths `/usr/bin/env`, `/usr/bin/grep`), `$0` resolved with `realpath` must be a regular file under the repository root, and HOME must equal the passwd home of the real uid (`/usr/bin/dscl . -read /Users/<user> NFSHomeDirectory` on macOS, `/usr/bin/getent passwd <uid>` on Linux), otherwise exit 2 with a named message. A caller-set sentinel variable is not a sanitization proof, because the caller controls it (ci-efficiency a04 and verdict a04 C-80 reviews, 2026-10-19). No script accepts a caller-supplied executable directory; interpreters are the fixed absolute paths item 9 names.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-trusted-exec-contract-tests-a01-audit-9545e59.md:2605:   105	3. **信頼パスの境界検査** 仕組みが信頼するパス（スクリプト、台帳、証跡、worktree、lock、出力先）は realpath で解決し、`.claude/worktrees/` または manifest の worker ルート配下なら拒否（ask/hold）。symlink 構成要素は解決後に比較し、大小文字を区別しないファイルシステムでは同一性比較を大小文字非依存で行う。 A validator or scanner enumerates its inputs by walking the filesystem under fixed roots (every regular file, ignored or untracked included), never by asking git which files exist: `git ls-files` trusts the index and the working-tree `.gitignore` rules, which a same-UID writer edits without a commit (a07 C-80 rounds 1 to 3, 2026-10-19); git is consulted only to confirm the root (`--show-toplevel` equality with a real `.git` directory) and never as an exclusion authority.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-trusted-exec-contract-tests-a01-audit-9545e59.md:2610:   110	8. **承認はコミット済み台帳から読む** permission の決定行（`scope=permission approved_by=user diff_sha256=…`）は anchored checkout の作業コピーではなく、コミット済みの台帳から読む。読み方は `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` が返す commit sha を取り、GitHub API（`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/contents/.orchestration/decisions.tsv?ref=<sha>`、sandbox 内）でその sha の内容を取得する。ローカルの `git show` は共有 object database が書けるため中間 tree の差し替えで偽物を返しうる（第 3 回審査の所見 2）（ローカルの ref 名 `origin/main` は経由しない。`refs/replace/` も書けるので replacement を無効にする。Codex worker は `.git/objects` と `.git/refs` に書けるので ref は差し替えられるが、sha で指した object は内容アドレスで偽造できない）。作業コピーの行は提案で、記録 PR が main にマージされて初めて承認になる（PR の承認は操作者の操作）。偽造には main へのマージが要る。 The same applies to the PR content a mechanism evaluates (the verdict, the audit precheck, the counters): the changeset is read from GitHub at the 40-hex head (`gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/<base40>...<head40>`, `…/contents/<path>?ref=<head40>`) or from a private clone whose object store no worker can write; the main checkout's shared `.git/objects` and its `origin/main` ref are not evidence sources, because Codex workers write them (a04 C-80 round 1, 2026-10-19). Evidence files are named and matched by the full 40-hex head, never by a 7-character prefix. Every `gh` invocation names the repository explicitly: `gh pr`, `gh run` and `gh issue` subcommands take `--repo mryfmo/dotfiles` or the full pull-request URL, and `gh api` (which has no `--repo` flag) takes the explicit `repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/…` endpoint path, never a `{owner}/{repo}` placeholder; a `gh api graphql` call binds the repository through fixed query variables (`owner: "mryfmo"`, `name: "dotfiles"` as constants in the script, passed with `-f`/`-F`) and uses only node ids obtained from a query bound by those variables (verdict a04 C-80 round 5, 2026-10-19): the local repository configuration selects the default repository otherwise, and a matching head sha does not bind the repository because a fork can hold the same commit (verdict a04 C-80 round 2, 2026-10-19). A mechanism whose application path runs code this contract does not yet cover (the agmsg storage layer sourced by `dispatch.sh`/`history.sh`; the integration gate until its own hardening task lands) names that task as the prerequisite of its `--apply` mode and runs shadow-only until the prerequisite is merged. The sha of canonical `main` comes from the fixed repository's API (`gh api repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha`), never from `git ls-remote origin`, whose destination the local remote and URL-rewrite configuration control (P1-12 a04 C-80, 2026-10-19T20:01Z); the content read at that sha comes from `repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/contents/<path>?ref=<sha40>`. Every `gh api` call that decides also binds the host with `--hostname github.com` (`GH_HOST` and the hosts configuration select the API host otherwise), a subcommand binds it through the `github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles` form of `--repo`, and a test that exports a hostile `GH_HOST` shows the call still names github.com or refuses (a02 review b2a186e, 2026-10-19T20:36Z).

が描画、operator が一度 login）で起動し、orchestrator の `~/.claude` と設定を共有しない。worker 設定：除外コマンド無し、Herdr socket 無し、sandbox の allowWrite は自席 worktree と agmsg store と席別キャッシュだけ、`failIfUnavailable: true`、信頼パス（anchored の強制範囲はユーザー設定ではなく **managed settings**（`/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、公式文書 "Repository settings under an admin-required sandbox"：project/local 設定は sandbox を無効化したり除外・socket を足したりできない）に置く。chezmoi は user ではこのファイルを書けないので、描画した内容を操作者が `sudo` で一度配置する（操作者手順）。worker 設定は worktree 自身の `.claude/**` と `.mcp.json` への Edit deny（`//<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/*/.claude/**`）を持つ（Bash 側は sandbox 既定の settings/hooks の denyWithinAllow）。agmsg store（全席が書く）から配送 hook が driver や plugin を source する上流の経路（storage.sh の `drivers.partition` traversal、`db/trusted-plugins` と `plugins/partition/shared.sh` による差し替え承認）は別タスク（agmsg hardening）の行で、worker 設定は `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/plugins/**` と `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/db/trusted-plugins` への書き込みを deny し（Edit deny は sandbox の deny にも合流する）、hook 側は store 由来の設定値を検証するまで残余と書く。managed settings の配置先は OS で異なる（macOS `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、Linux `/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json`）。hook は agmsg 配送だけを、hook コマンドを `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<home> …` で始めて（`BASH_ENV` などの継承環境を bash 起動前に消す；PATH 固定だけでは BASH_ENV が先に走る）絶対パスのインタプリタで呼び（上流の agmsg スクリプトは `/usr/bin/env bash` の shebang を持つので、hook 実行環境の PATH が shim を含まないことで束縛する）、各 hook に `onFailure: "block"`。公式文書：linked worktree の session は **main checkout の `.claude/settings.local.json` を読む**ので、worker 向けの hook を worktree の settings.local.json に書いても読まれず、逆に orchestrator の local hooks が worker session でも走る。したがって orchestrator 側の local hooks も guard 経由にし、worker 側の hook は worker config dir の settings に置く。Edit deny の一覧は `git ls-tree` ではなく描画時の静的一覧（manifest に列挙、`.agents/worklog/**` と `.agents/worklog/uv-cache/**` を含む）とし、`~/.agents/**` の全面 deny は agmsg store の書き込みと矛盾するので、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.agents/skills/**/scripts/**`、`~/.agents/model-profiles.env` などストア以外を列挙する。公式文書で確認した事実（2026-10-19）：`Edit(path)` の deny は Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit にも効き、deny → ask → allow の順で最初の一致が決まる；ただし Read/Edit の deny は **Bash sandbox の設定にも合流する**（"Paths and domains from both sandbox settings and permission rules are merged into the final sandbox configuration"）ので、ユーザー設定（全席共有）に `.orchestration/**` の Edit deny を書くと orchestrator の Bash による記録書き込みも止まる。hook は起動時に固定されず、設定ファイルの編集は file watcher が即座に反映する。`sandbox.failIfUnavailable` の既定は fail-open（依存が無ければ sandbox 無しで実行）。したがって Claude 席の境界は Edit deny 規則ではなく、**ユーザーレベルの PreToolUse hook**（`~/.claude/hooks/worker-write-boundary`、chezmoi が描画、`/bin/sh` または絶対パスの `python3 -I`）で作る：cwd の realpath が `<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/` 配下の session では、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit の対象が cwd の外、または `<cwd>/.claude/**`・`<cwd>/.mcp.json` のとき `permissionDecision: deny` を返す。Bash 側は sandbox の既定 `denyWithinAllow`（settings、hooks）と `allowWrite`（自席 worktree）が担う。`failIfUnavailable: true` を全席に置く。 Codex 席は sandbox（workspace-write）がツールの書き込み全部を自席の worktree と列挙パスに限る。Claude 席は Seatbelt sandbox が Bash を限るだけで、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit、hook、MCP プロセスは sandbox 外で動き、permission policy（permgate の決定論ポリシー）が path で拒否しない限り anchored checkout や `~/.agents` にも書ける（2026-10-19 時点、描画済み設定にその deny は無い）。したがって前提 6 は「Codex 席は成立、Claude 席は P1-15 が描画設定に Edit の path deny を入れるまで残余」と書く。P1-15 以前に「worker は信頼ルートに書けない」と書く文は誤りで、C-80 が拒否する。P1-15 が入るまで、承認の出所は項目 8 の「コミット済み台帳」で守る。書き込みは自席の worktree（`.claude/worktrees/<name>`）、scratch、列挙されたツールキャッシュに限る。anchored checkout（`.claude/worktrees/` 以外）、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.claude/hooks`、信頼ルートのバイナリ、orchestrator の証跡・スナップショット・lock は worker から書けない。render テストが描画後の deny を検証する。残余は「どの席 sandbox にも属さない同一 UID プロセス」と、Worker Playbook step 4 が sandbox 外に出す少数のコマンド（gh）。後者は D-024-17（P1-15）で絶対パスの実行体に束縛する。

.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-verdict-audit-pool-a04-text-security-6748694.md:2289:1. **書き込み境界（前提 6、ランタイム別に正直に）** Claude worker 席は専用の設定ディレクトリ `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-worker`（chezmoi が描画、operator が一度 login）で起動し、orchestrator の `~/.claude` と設定を共有しない。worker 設定：除外コマンド無し、Herdr socket 無し、sandbox の allowWrite は自席 worktree と agmsg store と席別キャッシュだけ、`failIfUnavailable: true`、信頼パス（anchored checkout の `.claude/worktrees/` 以外、`~/.agents`、`~/.claude*`、`~/.local`、`~/.config`）への Edit deny（公式文書：file tool の permission 検査は要求パスと symlink 解決後のパスの両方に deny を適用し、symlink そのものへの書き込みは拒否する）、sandbox の強制範囲はユーザー設定ではなく **managed settings**（`/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、公式文書 "Repository settings under an admin-required sandbox"：project/local 設定は sandbox を無効化したり除外・socket を足したりできない）に置く。chezmoi は user ではこのファイルを書けないので、描画した内容を操作者が `sudo` で一度配置する（操作者手順）。worker 設定は worktree 自身の `.claude/**` と `.mcp.json` への Edit deny（`//<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/*/.claude/**`）を持つ（Bash 側は sandbox 既定の settings/hooks の denyWithinAllow）。agmsg store（全席が書く）から配送 hook が driver や plugin を source する上流の経路（storage.sh の `drivers.partition` traversal、`db/trusted-plugins` と `plugins/partition/shared.sh` による差し替え承認）は別タスク（agmsg hardening）の行で、worker 設定は `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/plugins/**` と `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/db/trusted-plugins` への書き込みを deny し（Edit deny は sandbox の deny にも合流する）、hook 側は store 由来の設定値を検証するまで残余と書く。managed settings の配置先は OS で異なる（macOS `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、Linux `/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json`）。hook は agmsg 配送だけを、hook コマンドを `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<home> …` で始めて（`BASH_ENV` などの継承環境を bash 起動前に消す；PATH 固定だけでは BASH_ENV が先に走る）絶対パスのインタプリタで呼び（上流の agmsg スクリプトは `/usr/bin/env bash` の shebang を持つので、hook 実行環境の PATH が shim を含まないことで束縛する）、各 hook に `onFailure: "block"`。公式文書：linked worktree の session は **main checkout の `.claude/settings.local.json` を読む**ので、worker 向けの hook を worktree の settings.local.json に書いても読まれず、逆に orchestrator の local hooks が worker session でも走る。したがって orchestrator 側の local hooks も guard 経由にし、worker 側の hook は worker config dir の settings に置く。Edit deny の一覧は `git ls-tree` ではなく描画時の静的一覧（manifest に列挙、`.agents/worklog/**` と `.agents/worklog/uv-cache/**` を含む）とし、`~/.agents/**` の全面 deny は agmsg store の書き込みと矛盾するので、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.agents/skills/**/scripts/**`、`~/.agents/model-profiles.env` などストア以外を列挙する。公式文書で確認した事実（2026-10-19）：`Edit(path)` の deny は Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit にも効き、deny → ask → allow の順で最初の一致が決まる；ただし Read/Edit の deny は **Bash sandbox の設定にも合流する**（"Paths and domains from both sandbox settings and permission rules are merged into the final sandbox configuration"）ので、ユーザー設定（全席共有）に `.orchestration/**` の Edit deny を書くと orchestrator の Bash による記録書き込みも止まる。hook は起動時に固定されず、設定ファイルの編集は file watcher が即座に反映する。`sandbox.failIfUnavailable` の既定は fail-open（依存が無ければ sandbox 無しで実行）。したがって Claude 席の境界は Edit deny 規則ではなく、**ユーザーレベルの PreToolUse hook**（`~/.claude/hooks/worker-write-boundary`、chezmoi が描画、`/bin/sh` または絶対パスの `python3 -I`）で作る：cwd の realpath が `<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/` 配下の session では、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit の対象が cwd の外、または `<cwd>/.claude/**`・`<cwd>/.mcp.json` のとき `permissionDecision: deny` を返す。Bash 側は sandbox の既定 `denyWithinAllow`（settings、hooks）と `allowWrite`（自席 worktree）が担う。`failIfUnavailable: true` を全席に置く。 Codex 席は sandbox（workspace-write）がツールの書き込み全部を自席の worktree と列挙パスに限る。Claude 席は Seatbelt sandbox が Bash を限るだけで、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit、hook、MCP プロセスは sandbox 外で動き、permission policy（permgate の決定論ポリシー）が path で拒否しない限り anchored checkout や `~/.agents` にも書ける（2026-10-19 時点、描画済み設定にその deny は無い）。したがって前提 6 は「Codex 席は成立、Claude 席は P1-15 が描画設定に Edit の path deny を入れるまで残余」と書く。P1-15 以前に「worker は信頼ルートに書けない」と書く文は誤りで、C-80 が拒否する。P1-15 が入るまで、承認の出所は項目 8 の「コミット済み台帳」で守る。書き込みは自席の worktree（`.claude/worktrees/<name>`）、scratch、列挙されたツールキャッシュに限る。anchored checkout（`.claude/worktrees/` 以外）、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.claude/hooks`、信頼ルートのバイナリ、orchestrator の証跡・スナップショット・lock は worker から書けない。render テストが描画後の deny を検証する。残余は「どの席 sandbox にも属さない同一 UID プロセス」と、Worker Playbook step 4 が sandbox 外に出す少数のコマンド（gh）。後者は D-024-17（P1-15）で絶対パスの実行体に束縛する。

admin-required sandbox"：project/local 設定は sandbox を無効化したり除外・socket を足したりできない）に置く。chezmoi は user ではこのファイルを書けないので、描画した内容を操作者が `sudo` で一度配置する（操作者手順）。worker 設定は worktree 自身の `.claude/**` と `.mcp.json` への Edit deny（`//<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/*/.claude/**`）を持つ（Bash 側は sandbox 既定の settings/hooks の denyWithinAllow）。agmsg store（全席が書く）から配送 hook が driver や plugin を source する上流の経路（storage.sh の `drivers.partition` traversal、`db/trusted-plugins` と `plugins/partition/shared.sh` による差し替え承認）は別タスク（agmsg hardening）の行で、worker 設定は `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/plugins/**` と `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/db/trusted-plugins` への書き込みを deny し（Edit deny は sandbox の deny にも合流する）、hook 側は store 由来の設定値を検証するまで残余と書く。managed settings の配置先は OS で異なる（macOS `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、Linux `/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json`）。hook は agmsg 配送だけを、hook コマンドを `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<home> …` で始めて（`BASH_ENV` などの継承環境を bash 起動前に消す；PATH 固定だけでは BASH_ENV が先に走る）絶対パスのインタプリタで呼び（上流の agmsg スクリプトは `/usr/bin/env bash` の shebang を持つので、hook 実行環境の PATH が shim を含まないことで束縛する）、各 hook に `onFailure: "block"`。公式文書：linked worktree の session は **main checkout の `.claude/settings.local.json` を読む**ので、worker 向けの hook を worktree の settings.local.json に書いても読まれず、逆に orchestrator の local hooks が worker session でも走る。したがって orchestrator 側の local hooks も guard 経由にし、worker 側の hook は worker config dir の settings に置く。Edit deny の一覧は `git ls-tree` ではなく描画時の静的一覧（manifest に列挙、`.agents/worklog/**` と `.agents/worklog/uv-cache/**` を含む）とし、`~/.agents/**` の全面 deny は agmsg store の書き込みと矛盾するので、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.agents/skills/**/scripts/**`、`~/.agents/model-profiles.env` などストア以外を列挙する。公式文書で確認した事実（2026-10-19）：`Edit(path)` の deny は Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit にも効き、deny → ask → allow の順で最初の一致が決まる；ただし Read/Edit の deny は **Bash sandbox の設定にも合流する**（"Paths and domains from both sandbox settings and permission rules are merged into the final sandbox configuration"）ので、ユーザー設定（全席共有）に `.orchestration/**` の Edit deny を書くと orchestrator の Bash による記録書き込みも止まる。hook は起動時に固定されず、設定ファイルの編集は file watcher が即座に反映する。`sandbox.failIfUnavailable` の既定は fail-open（依存が無ければ sandbox 無しで実行）。したがって Claude 席の境界は Edit deny 規則ではなく、**ユーザーレベルの PreToolUse hook**（`~/.claude/hooks/worker-write-boundary`、chezmoi が描画、`/bin/sh` または絶対パスの `python3 -I`）で作る：cwd の realpath が `<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/` 配下の session では、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit の対象が cwd の外、または `<cwd>/.claude/**`・`<cwd>/.mcp.json` のとき `permissionDecision: deny` を返す。Bash 側は sandbox の既定 `denyWithinAllow`（settings、hooks）と `allowWrite`（自席 worktree）が担う。`failIfUnavailable: true` を全席に置く。 Codex 席は sandbox（workspace-write）がツールの書き込み全部を自席の worktree と列挙パスに限る。Claude 席は Seatbelt sandbox が Bash を限るだけで、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit、hook、MCP プロセスは sandbox 外で動き、permission policy（permgate の決定論ポリシー）が path で拒否しない限り anchored checkout や `~/.agents` にも書ける（2026-10-19 時点、描画済み設定にその deny は無い）。したがって前提 6 は「Codex 席は成立、Claude 席は P1-15 が描画設定に Edit の path deny を入れるまで残余」と書く。P1-15 以前に「worker は信頼ルートに書けない」と書く文は誤りで、C-80 が拒否する。P1-15 が入るまで、承認の出所は項目 8 の「コミット済み台帳」で守る。書き込みは自席の worktree（`.claude/worktrees/<name>`）、scratch、列挙されたツールキャッシュに限る。anchored checkout（`.claude/worktrees/` 以外）、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.claude/hooks`、信頼ルートのバイナリ、orchestrator の証跡・スナップショット・lock は worker から書けない。render テストが描画後の deny を検証する。残余は「どの席 sandbox にも属さない同一 UID プロセス」と、Worker Playbook step 4 が sandbox 外に出す少数のコマンド（gh）。後者は D-024-17（P1-15）で絶対パスの実行体に束縛する。 The protected-path inventory a seat's Edit denies cover is enumerated from the inputs of every trusted executable, not only the executables: it includes `~/.agents/permgate-policy.yaml` (permgate rereads it for every decision), `~/.local/lib/python*/site-packages` and every other user-site or startup-hook location of the interpreters in use (`.pth`, `usercustomize.py`, `sitecustomize.py`), `~/.claude-worker`'s hook and settings files, and the rendered guard; a text that binds an executable names its inputs in the same inventory (P1-15 amendment 5 C-80, 2026-10-19). The inventory of executable configuration sources a worker start screens is the documented loading list of the installed Claude Code version, enumerated once from the documentation (settings: user, project, local and managed `settings.json`; project `.mcp.json`; the configuration directory's global state `.claude.json` with user-scoped and project-local MCP servers; plugins and skills directories (`.claude/skills/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, enabled plugins); hook handlers of every documented type (`command`, `http` and any other `type` value the hooks reference lists: a handler is an executable input whether it names a command or a URL, and a worker start refuses every handler type but `command`), `apiKeyHelper`, `statusLine.command`, MCP server commands), and the launcher screens or disables every source before accepting workspace trust, refusing any executable payload it did not write; adding sources one review at a time is the anti-pattern (P1-15 a02 reviews 2ae9e2c and ebbb71b, 2026-10-19). The enumeration quotes the documentation's values (the page, its fetched_at and the listed values) in the text's premises so a reviewer can check them against the live page; naming a source by one of its fields ("hook commands" for hook handlers) is the same anti-pattern one level down (a02 review b2a186e, 2026-10-19T20:36Z; C-95).
