`denyWithinAllow`（settings、hooks）と `allowWrite`（自席 worktree）が担う。`failIfUnavailable: true` を全席に置く。 Codex 席は sandbox（workspace-write）がツールの書き込み全部を自席の worktree と列挙パスに限る。Claude 席は Seatbelt sandbox が Bash を限るだけで、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit、hook、MCP プロセスは sandbox 外で動き、permission policy（permgate の決定論ポリシー）が path で拒否しない限り anchored checkout や `~/.agents` にも書ける（2026-10-19 時点、描画済み設定にその deny は無い）。したがって前提 6 は「Codex 席は成立、Claude 席は P1-15 が描画設定に Edit の path deny を入れるまで残余」と書く。P1-15 以前に「worker は信頼ルートに書けない」と書く文は誤りで、C-80 が拒否する。P1-15 が入るまで、承認の出所は項目 8 の「コミット済み台帳」で守る。書き込みは自席の worktree（`.claude/worktrees/<name>`）、scratch、列挙されたツールキャッシュに限る。anchored checkout（`.claude/worktrees/` 以外）、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.claude/hooks`、信頼ルートのバイナリ、orchestrator の証跡・スナップショット・lock は worker から書けない。render テストが描画後の deny を検証する。残余は「どの席 sandbox にも属さない同一 UID プロセス」と、Worker Playbook step 4 が sandbox 外に出す少数のコマンド（gh）。後者は D-024-17（P1-15）で絶対パスの実行体に束縛する。 The protected-path inventory a seat's Edit denies cover is enumerated from the inputs of every trusted executable, not only the executables: it includes `~/.agents/permgate-policy.yaml` (permgate rereads it for every decision), `~/.local/lib/python*/site-packages` and every other user-site or startup-hook location of the interpreters in use (`.pth`, `usercustomize.py`, `sitecustomize.py`), `~/.claude-worker`'s hook and settings files, and the rendered guard; a text that binds an executable names its inputs in the same inventory (P1-15 amendment 5 C-80, 2026-10-19). The inventory of executable configuration sources a worker start screens is the documented loading list of the installed Claude Code version, enumerated once from the documentation (settings: user, project, local and managed `settings.json`; project `.mcp.json`; the configuration directory's global state `.claude.json` with user-scoped and project-local MCP servers; plugins and skills directories (`.claude/skills/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, enabled plugins); hook handlers of every documented type (`command`, `http` and any other `type` value the hooks reference lists: a handler is an executable input whether it names a command or a URL, and a worker start refuses every handler type but `command`), `apiKeyHelper`, `statusLine.command`, MCP server commands), and the launcher screens or disables every source before accepting workspace trust, refusing any executable payload it did not write; adding sources one review at a time is the anti-pattern (P1-15 a02 reviews 2ae9e2c and ebbb71b, 2026-10-19). The enumeration quotes the documentation's values (the page, its fetched_at and the listed values) in the text's premises so a reviewer can check them against the live page; naming a source by one of its fields ("hook commands" for hook handlers) is the same anti-pattern one level down (a02 review b2a186e, 2026-10-19T20:36Z; C-95).
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-task-generator-plan-check-a05-checker-security-06ffefb.md:3098:2. **無害化した環境を最初に** 最初の処理として `env -i` に入り、PATH は信頼ルートで解決した絶対バイナリへのリンクだけの私設ディレクトリ（shims、空、相対は拒否）。git は毎回 `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.fsmonitor=false -c protocol.allow=never -c protocol.https.allow=always` と明示 `-C`（https だけ許す。`protocol.allow=never` 単独は必要な fetch を止める）。 検査の読み取りは `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1` で部分クローンの遅延 fetch（checkout 設定の credential.helper を起動しうる）を止め、`-c submodule.recurse=false --ignore-submodules=all` で submodule 内の status/diff（submodule 自身の設定が filter を有効化しうる）を止める。`.gitmodules` を持つ checkout は検査対象として拒否する。 `-C` は作業木を束縛しないので（repo-local の `core.worktree` が読み先を checkout 外へ向けられる）、git は `--git-dir=<checkout>/.git --work-tree=<checkout>` を明示し、`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` の realpath が checkout と一致しないときは拒否する。 premise や検査の「コマンド実行」は、固定語彙の読み取り専用プローブ（`git rev-parse <ref>`、`test -e <path>`、`grep -c <pattern> <file>` のように検査器自身が解釈する形）だけを許し、任意のシェル文字列は実行しない（本文のハッシュはコマンド文を認証するだけで、`python -I scripts/x.py` のファイル被演算子や `source ./x.sh` の中身は認証しない）。diff と show は `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv` と `-c core.attributesFile=/dev/null -c core.sshCommand=false` を付け、PR 側の `.gitattributes`（external diff、textconv、filter）が検査内容や実行物を変えないようにする。Python は `-I`。PATH 探索で実行するものは無い。 A shell script that runs under a PR-controlled or worker-controlled environment (verdict.sh, the chain glue, CI steps) is executed as a program with `#!/bin/bash -p`, never as `bash <file>`, and only by a trusted parent that supplies the clean environment before the exec: `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<passwd home> LANG=C.UTF-8 /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -p <absolute script path> …` (long options before `-p`). Privileged mode discards inherited functions, `BASH_ENV`/`ENV`, `SHELLOPTS`, `BASHOPTS`, `CDPATH` and `GLOBIGNORE`, but on Linux an inherited `LD_PRELOAD`/`LD_AUDIT` already executes while the loader maps `/bin/bash`, before `-p` or any statement runs, so a self re-exec inside the script is not a boundary and re-executing `"$0"` would reopen the caller's pathname (a worker-owned symlink can be swapped between the two executions); the program therefore verifies and refuses instead of repairing: its environment must consist of exactly the allowed names (checked through absolute paths `/usr/bin/env`, `/usr/bin/grep`), `$0` resolved with `realpath` must be a regular file under the repository root, and HOME must equal the passwd home of the real uid (`/usr/bin/dscl . -read /Users/<user> NFSHomeDirectory` on macOS, `/usr/bin/getent passwd <uid>` on Linux), otherwise exit 2 with a named message. A caller-set sentinel variable is not a sanitization proof, because the caller controls it (ci-efficiency a04 and verdict a04 C-80 reviews, 2026-10-19). No script accepts a caller-supplied executable directory; interpreters are the fixed absolute paths item 9 names.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-task-generator-plan-check-a05-checker-security-06ffefb.md:3099:3. **信頼パスの境界検査** 仕組みが信頼するパス（スクリプト、台帳、証跡、worktree、lock、出力先）は realpath で解決し、`.claude/worktrees/` または manifest の worker ルート配下なら拒否（ask/hold）。symlink 構成要素は解決後に比較し、大小文字を区別しないファイルシステムでは同一性比較を大小文字非依存で行う。 A validator or scanner enumerates its inputs by walking the filesystem under fixed roots (every regular file, ignored or untracked included), never by asking git which files exist: `git ls-files` trusts the index and the working-tree `.gitignore` rules, which a same-UID writer edits without a commit (a07 C-80 rounds 1 to 3, 2026-10-19); git is consulted only to confirm the root (`--show-toplevel` equality with a real `.git` directory) and never as an exclusion authority.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-task-generator-plan-check-a05-checker-security-06ffefb.md:3104:8. **承認はコミット済み台帳から読む** permission の決定行（`scope=permission approved_by=user diff_sha256=…`）は anchored checkout の作業コピーではなく、コミット済みの台帳から読む。読み方は `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` が返す commit sha を取り、GitHub API（`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/contents/.orchestration/decisions.tsv?ref=<sha>`、sandbox 内）でその sha の内容を取得する。ローカルの `git show` は共有 object database が書けるため中間 tree の差し替えで偽物を返しうる（第 3 回審査の所見 2）（ローカルの ref 名 `origin/main` は経由しない。`refs/replace/` も書けるので replacement を無効にする。Codex worker は `.git/objects` と `.git/refs` に書けるので ref は差し替えられるが、sha で指した object は内容アドレスで偽造できない）。作業コピーの行は提案で、記録 PR が main にマージされて初めて承認になる（PR の承認は操作者の操作）。偽造には main へのマージが要る。 The same applies to the PR content a mechanism evaluates (the verdict, the audit precheck, the counters): the changeset is read from GitHub at the 40-hex head (`gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/<base40>...<head40>`, `…/contents/<path>?ref=<head40>`) or from a private clone whose object store no worker can write; the main checkout's shared `.git/objects` and its `origin/main` ref are not evidence sources, because Codex workers write them (a04 C-80 round 1, 2026-10-19). Evidence files are named and matched by the full 40-hex head, never by a 7-character prefix. Every `gh` invocation names the repository explicitly: `gh pr`, `gh run` and `gh issue` subcommands take `--repo mryfmo/dotfiles` or the full pull-request URL, and `gh api` (which has no `--repo` flag) takes the explicit `repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/…` endpoint path, never a `{owner}/{repo}` placeholder; a `gh api graphql` call binds the repository through fixed query variables (`owner: "mryfmo"`, `name: "dotfiles"` as constants in the script, passed with `-f`/`-F`) and uses only node ids obtained from a query bound by those variables (verdict a04 C-80 round 5, 2026-10-19): the local repository configuration selects the default repository otherwise, and a matching head sha does not bind the repository because a fork can hold the same commit (verdict a04 C-80 round 2, 2026-10-19). A mechanism whose application path runs code this contract does not yet cover (the agmsg storage layer sourced by `dispatch.sh`/`history.sh`; the integration gate until its own hardening task lands) names that task as the prerequisite of its `--apply` mode and runs shadow-only until the prerequisite is merged. The sha of canonical `main` comes from the fixed repository's API (`gh api repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha`), never from `git ls-remote origin`, whose destination the local remote and URL-rewrite configuration control (P1-12 a04 C-80, 2026-10-19T20:01Z); the content read at that sha comes from `repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/contents/<path>?ref=<sha40>`. Every `gh api` call that decides also binds the host with `--hostname github.com` (`GH_HOST` and the hosts configuration select the API host otherwise), a subcommand binds it through the `github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles` form of `--repo`, and a test that exports a hostile `GH_HOST` shows the call still names github.com or refuses (a02 review b2a186e, 2026-10-19T20:36Z).
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-task-generator-plan-check-a05-checker-security-06ffefb.md:3105:9. **私設キャッシュ** orchestrator 側の実行は worker と共有するキャッシュ（`~/.cache/uv`、`~/.local/share/uv`、mise）から実行可能物を読まない。`UV_CACHE_DIR` を anchored checkout 配下（`.agents/worklog/uv-cache`、gitignored、worker 書き込み不可）に固定し、`uv run --no-config --no-project --offline --python <信頼ルートの絶対パスのインタプリタ>` で起動する（`--no-config` で uv の設定探索を止め、`--python` の絶対パスで cwd や親の `.venv` の発見を止める；敵対的な `.venv` と `uv.toml` を置いた fixture で検証）。hook は uv を使わず jq と python 標準ライブラリだけで動く。 One trusted interpreter resolver (`scripts/orchestrator/trusted-interpreter.sh`, P1-3 lineage) resolves `<abs>` from the repository's pinned declaration to a regular file under the tool manager's install root (the install root is anchored to the passwd home of the real uid, never to the HOME variable, which a caller can forge), refuses anything else, and every orchestrator-side script consumes it; no script keeps its own `command -v`, `mise which` or PATH fallback (ci-rerun.sh security review 44cb835, 2026-10-19). Shell code of other projects (the agmsg storage layer and its `drivers.partition` sourcing) is never sourced by an orchestrator-side mechanism; counters are read from the agmsg SQLite store read-only with a fixed query or from the pasted record. Every Python child of a trusted entrypoint runs with `-I` (isolated: no user site, no `PYTHON*` environment, no script directory on `sys.path`), so `uv run … python -I <script>` rather than `--script` for a script without declared dependencies; a test plants a `.pth` and a `usercustomize.py` in a fake user site and asserts they never execute (P1-15 amendment 5 C-80, 2026-10-19). A program takes `UV_CACHE_DIR` from the environment the trusted parent supplies and refuses when it is absent or not an absolute path; it never computes a default from its own root. The orchestrator's parent prefix sets the main checkout's `.agents/worklog/uv-cache`; a worker's launcher sets `<worktree>/.uv-cache` (the P1-15 worker launch value: `.agents/` is read-only in the Codex permission profile, so a root-derived `.agents/worklog/uv-cache` cannot be created by a worker; P1-12 a03, 2026-10-19T11:28Z); tests set a temporary directory.

.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-verdict-audit-pool-a04-text-security-12b9ebf.md:2599:> 2. **無害化した環境を最初に** 最初の処理として `env -i` に入り、PATH は信頼ルートで解決した絶対バイナリへのリンクだけの私設ディレクトリ（shims、空、相対は拒否）。git は毎回 `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.fsmonitor=false -c protocol.allow=never -c protocol.https.allow=always` と明示 `-C`（https だけ許す。`protocol.allow=never` 単独は必要な fetch を止める）。 検査の読み取りは `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1` で部分クローンの遅延 fetch（checkout 設定の credential.helper を起動しうる）を止め、`-c submodule.recurse=false --ignore-submodules=all` で submodule 内の status/diff（submodule 自身の設定が filter を有効化しうる）を止める。`.gitmodules` を持つ checkout は検査対象として拒否する。 `-C` は作業木を束縛しないので（repo-local の `core.worktree` が読み先を checkout 外へ向けられる）、git は `--git-dir=<checkout>/.git --work-tree=<checkout>` を明示し、`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` の realpath が checkout と一致しないときは拒否する。 premise や検査の「コマンド実行」は、固定語彙の読み取り専用プローブ（`git rev-parse <ref>`、`test -e <path>`、`grep -c <pattern> <file>` のように検査器自身が解釈する形）だけを許し、任意のシェル文字列は実行しない（本文のハッシュはコマンド文を認証するだけで、`python -I scripts/x.py` のファイル被演算子や `source ./x.sh` の中身は認証しない）。diff と show は `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv` と `-c core.attributesFile=/dev/null -c core.sshCommand=false` を付け、PR 側の `.gitattributes`（external diff、textconv、filter）が検査内容や実行物を変えないようにする。Python は `-I`。PATH 探索で実行するものは無い。 A shell script that runs under a PR-controlled or worker-controlled environment (verdict.sh, the chain glue, CI steps) is executed as a program with `#!/bin/bash -p`, never as `bash <file>`, and only by a trusted parent that supplies the clean environment before the exec: `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<passwd home> LANG=C.UTF-8 /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -p <absolute script path> …` (long options before `-p`). Privileged mode discards inherited functions, `BASH_ENV`/`ENV`, `SHELLOPTS`, `BASHOPTS`, `CDPATH` and `GLOBIGNORE`, but on Linux an inherited `LD_PRELOAD`/`LD_AUDIT` already executes while the loader maps `/bin/bash`, before `-p` or any statement runs, so a self re-exec inside the script is not a boundary and re-executing `"$0"` would reopen the caller's pathname (a worker-owned symlink can be swapped between the two executions); the program therefore verifies and refuses instead of repairing: its environment must consist of exactly the allowed names (checked through absolute paths `/usr/bin/env`, `/usr/bin/grep`), `$0` resolved with `realpath` must be a regular file under the repository root, and HOME must equal the passwd home of the real uid (`/usr/bin/dscl . -read /Users/<user> NFSHomeDirectory` on macOS, `/usr/bin/getent passwd <uid>` on Linux), otherwise exit 2 with a named message. A caller-set sentinel variable is not a sanitization proof, because the caller controls it (ci-efficiency a04 and verdict a04 C-80 reviews, 2026-10-19). No script accepts a caller-supplied executable directory; interpreters are the fixed absolute paths item 9 names.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-verdict-audit-pool-a04-text-security-12b9ebf.md:2605:> 8. **承認はコミット済み台帳から読む** permission の決定行（`scope=permission approved_by=user diff_sha256=…`）は anchored checkout の作業コピーではなく、コミット済みの台帳から読む。読み方は `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` が返す commit sha を取り、GitHub API（`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/contents/.orchestration/decisions.tsv?ref=<sha>`、sandbox 内）でその sha の内容を取得する。ローカルの `git show` は共有 object database が書けるため中間 tree の差し替えで偽物を返しうる（第 3 回審査の所見 2）（ローカルの ref 名 `origin/main` は経由しない。`refs/replace/` も書けるので replacement を無効にする。Codex worker は `.git/objects` と `.git/refs` に書けるので ref は差し替えられるが、sha で指した object は内容アドレスで偽造できない）。作業コピーの行は提案で、記録 PR が main にマージされて初めて承認になる（PR の承認は操作者の操作）。偽造には main へのマージが要る。 The same applies to the PR content a mechanism evaluates (the verdict, the audit precheck, the counters): the changeset is read from GitHub at the 40-hex head (`gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/<base40>...<head40>`, `…/contents/<path>?ref=<head40>`) or from a private clone whose object store no worker can write; the main checkout's shared `.git/objects` and its `origin/main` ref are not evidence sources, because Codex workers write them (a04 C-80 round 1, 2026-10-19). Evidence files are named and matched by the full 40-hex head, never by a 7-character prefix. Every `gh` invocation names the repository explicitly (`--repo mryfmo/dotfiles` or the full pull-request URL): the local repository configuration selects the default repository otherwise, and a matching head sha does not bind the repository because a fork can hold the same commit (verdict a04 C-80 round 2, 2026-10-19). A mechanism whose application path runs code this contract does not yet cover (the agmsg storage layer sourced by `dispatch.sh`/`history.sh`; the integration gate until its own hardening task lands) names that task as the prerequisite of its `--apply` mode and runs shadow-only until the prerequisite is merged.

.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-verdict-audit-pool-a04-text-security-12b9ebf.md:2664:105:3. **信頼パスの境界検査** 仕組みが信頼するパス（スクリプト、台帳、証跡、worktree、lock、出力先）は realpath で解決し、`.claude/worktrees/` または manifest の worker ルート配下なら拒否（ask/hold）。symlink 構成要素は解決後に比較し、大小文字を区別しないファイルシステムでは同一性比較を大小文字非依存で行う。 A validator or scanner enumerates its inputs by walking the filesystem under fixed roots (every regular file, ignored or untracked included), never by asking git which files exist: `git ls-files` trusts the index and the working-tree `.gitignore` rules, which a same-UID writer edits without a commit (a07 C-80 rounds 1 to 3, 2026-10-19); git is consulted only to confirm the root (`--show-toplevel` equality with a real `.git` directory) and never as an exclusion authority.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-verdict-audit-pool-a04-text-security-12b9ebf.md:2667:110:8. **承認はコミット済み台帳から読む** permission の決定行（`scope=permission approved_by=user diff_sha256=…`）は anchored checkout の作業コピーではなく、コミット済みの台帳から読む。読み方は `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` が返す commit sha を取り、GitHub API（`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/contents/.orchestration/decisions.tsv?ref=<sha>`、sandbox 内）でその sha の内容を取得する。ローカルの `git show` は共有 object database が書けるため中間 tree の差し替えで偽物を返しうる（第 3 回審査の所見 2）（ローカルの ref 名 `origin/main` は経由しない。`refs/replace/` も書けるので replacement を無効にする。Codex worker は `.git/objects` と `.git/refs` に書けるので ref は差し替えられるが、sha で指した object は内容アドレスで偽造できない）。作業コピーの行は提案で、記録 PR が main にマージされて初めて承認になる（PR の承認は操作者の操作）。偽造には main へのマージが要る。 The same applies to the PR content a mechanism evaluates (the verdict, the audit precheck, the counters): the changeset is read from GitHub at the 40-hex head (`gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/<base40>...<head40>`, `…/contents/<path>?ref=<head40>`) or from a private clone whose object store no worker can write; the main checkout's shared `.git/objects` and its `origin/main` ref are not evidence sources, because Codex workers write them (a04 C-80 round 1, 2026-10-19). Evidence files are named and matched by the full 40-hex head, never by a 7-character prefix. Every `gh` invocation names the repository explicitly (`--repo mryfmo/dotfiles` or the full pull-request URL): the local repository configuration selects the default repository otherwise, and a matching head sha does not bind the repository because a fork can hold the same commit (verdict a04 C-80 round 2, 2026-10-19). A mechanism whose application path runs code this contract does not yet cover (the agmsg storage layer sourced by `dispatch.sh`/`history.sh`; the integration gate until its own hardening task lands) names that task as the prerequisite of its `--apply` mode and runs shadow-only until the prerequisite is merged.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-verdict-audit-pool-a04-text-security-12b9ebf.md:2685:orchestrator 側の仕組み（merge gate、integrate-merge、orch-gate、dispositions、audit-pool、verdict、chain）は、同じホスト上で同じ UID の worker プロセスと共存する。2026-10-19 の C-80 審査（a05、dispositions-a02、audit-pool-a01 の 3 文、計 19 件の P1）は、どの文も同じ前提を書かず同じ穴を持つことを示した。以後、`security: true` の orchestrator 側タスク文は本節を参照で適用し、本節の各項目に対応する threat 行を持つ。文ごとに言い換えない。
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-verdict-audit-pool-a04-text-security-12b9ebf.md:2687:1. **書き込み境界（前提 6、ランタイム別に正直に）** Claude worker 席は専用の設定ディレクトリ `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-worker`（chezmoi が描画、operator が一度 login）で起動し、orchestrator の `~/.claude` と設定を共有しない。worker 設定：除外コマンド無し、Herdr socket 無し、sandbox の allowWrite は自席 worktree と agmsg store と席別キャッシュだけ、`failIfUnavailable: true`、信頼パス（anchored checkout の `.claude/worktrees/` 以外、`~/.agents`、`~/.claude*`、`~/.local`、`~/.config`）への Edit deny（公式文書：file tool の permission 検査は要求パスと symlink 解決後のパスの両方に deny を適用し、symlink そのものへの書き込みは拒否する）、sandbox の強制範囲はユーザー設定ではなく **managed settings**（`/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、公式文書 "Repository settings under an admin-required sandbox"：project/local 設定は sandbox を無効化したり除外・socket を足したりできない）に置く。chezmoi は user ではこのファイルを書けないので、描画した内容を操作者が `sudo` で一度配置する（操作者手順）。worker 設定は worktree 自身の `.claude/**` と `.mcp.json` への Edit deny（`//<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/*/.claude/**`）を持つ（Bash 側は sandbox 既定の settings/hooks の denyWithinAllow）。agmsg store（全席が書く）から配送 hook が driver や plugin を source する上流の経路（storage.sh の `drivers.partition` traversal、`db/trusted-plugins` と `plugins/partition/shared.sh` による差し替え承認）は別タスク（agmsg hardening）の行で、worker 設定は `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/plugins/**` と `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/db/trusted-plugins` への書き込みを deny し（Edit deny は sandbox の deny にも合流する）、hook 側は store 由来の設定値を検証するまで残余と書く。managed settings の配置先は OS で異なる（macOS `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、Linux `/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json`）。hook は agmsg 配送だけを、hook コマンドを `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<home> …` で始めて（`BASH_ENV` などの継承環境を bash 起動前に消す；PATH 固定だけでは BASH_ENV が先に走る）絶対パスのインタプリタで呼び（上流の agmsg スクリプトは `/usr/bin/env bash` の shebang を持つので、hook 実行環境の PATH が shim を含まないことで束縛する）、各 hook に `onFailure: "block"`。公式文書：linked worktree の session は **main checkout の `.claude/settings.local.json` を読む**ので、worker 向けの hook を worktree の settings.local.json に書いても読まれず、逆に orchestrator の local hooks が worker session でも走る。したがって orchestrator 側の local hooks も guard 経由にし、worker 側の hook は worker config dir の settings に置く。Edit deny の一覧は `git ls-tree` ではなく描画時の静的一覧（manifest に列挙、`.agents/worklog/**` と `.agents/worklog/uv-cache/**` を含む）とし、`~/.agents/**` の全面 deny は agmsg store の書き込みと矛盾するので、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.agents/skills/**/scripts/**`、`~/.agents/model-profiles.env` などストア以外を列挙する。公式文書で確認した事実（2026-10-19）：`Edit(path)` の deny は Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit にも効き、deny → ask → allow の順で最初の一致が決まる；ただし Read/Edit の deny は **Bash sandbox の設定にも合流する**（"Paths and domains from both sandbox settings and permission rules are merged into the final sandbox configuration"）ので、ユーザー設定（全席共有）に `.orchestration/**` の Edit deny を書くと orchestrator の Bash による記録書き込みも止まる。hook は起動時に固定されず、設定ファイルの編集は file watcher が即座に反映する。`sandbox.failIfUnavailable` の既定は fail-open（依存が無ければ sandbox 無しで実行）。したがって Claude 席の境界は Edit deny 規則ではなく、**ユーザーレベルの PreToolUse hook**（`~/.claude/hooks/worker-write-boundary`、chezmoi が描画、`/bin/sh` または絶対パスの `python3 -I`）で作る：cwd の realpath が `<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/` 配下の session では、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit の対象が cwd の外、または `<cwd>/.claude/**`・`<cwd>/.mcp.json` のとき `permissionDecision: deny` を返す。Bash 側は sandbox の既定 `denyWithinAllow`（settings、hooks）と `allowWrite`（自席 worktree）が担う。`failIfUnavailable: true` を全席に置く。 Codex 席は sandbox（workspace-write）がツールの書き込み全部を自席の worktree と列挙パスに限る。Claude 席は Seatbelt sandbox が Bash を限るだけで、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit、hook、MCP プロセスは sandbox 外で動き、permission policy（permgate の決定論ポリシー）が path で拒否しない限り anchored checkout や `~/.agents` にも書ける（2026-10-19 時点、描画済み設定にその deny は無い）。したがって前提 6 は「Codex 席は成立、Claude 席は P1-15 が描画設定に Edit の path deny を入れるまで残余」と書く。P1-15 以前に「worker は信頼ルートに書けない」と書く文は誤りで、C-80 が拒否する。P1-15 が入るまで、承認の出所は項目 8 の「コミット済み台帳」で守る。書き込みは自席の worktree（`.claude/worktrees/<name>`）、scratch、列挙されたツールキャッシュに限る。anchored checkout（`.claude/worktrees/` 以外）、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.claude/hooks`、信頼ルートのバイナリ、orchestrator の証跡・スナップショット・lock は worker から書けない。render テストが描画後の deny を検証する。残余は「どの席 sandbox にも属さない同一 UID プロセス」と、Worker Playbook step 4 が sandbox 外に出す少数のコマンド（gh）。後者は D-024-17（P1-15）で絶対パスの実行体に束縛する。
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-verdict-audit-pool-a04-text-security-12b9ebf.md:2688:2. **無害化した環境を最初に** 最初の処理として `env -i` に入り、PATH は信頼ルートで解決した絶対バイナリへのリンクだけの私設ディレクトリ（shims、空、相対は拒否）。git は毎回 `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.fsmonitor=false -c protocol.allow=never -c protocol.https.allow=always` と明示 `-C`（https だけ許す。`protocol.allow=never` 単独は必要な fetch を止める）。 検査の読み取りは `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1` で部分クローンの遅延 fetch（checkout 設定の credential.helper を起動しうる）を止め、`-c submodule.recurse=false --ignore-submodules=all` で submodule 内の status/diff（submodule 自身の設定が filter を有効化しうる）を止める。`.gitmodules` を持つ checkout は検査対象として拒否する。 `-C` は作業木を束縛しないので（repo-local の `core.worktree` が読み先を checkout 外へ向けられる）、git は `--git-dir=<checkout>/.git --work-tree=<checkout>` を明示し、`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` の realpath が checkout と一致しないときは拒否する。 premise や検査の「コマンド実行」は、固定語彙の読み取り専用プローブ（`git rev-parse <ref>`、`test -e <path>`、`grep -c <pattern> <file>` のように検査器自身が解釈する形）だけを許し、任意のシェル文字列は実行しない（本文のハッシュはコマンド文を認証するだけで、`python -I scripts/x.py` のファイル被演算子や `source ./x.sh` の中身は認証しない）。diff と show は `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv` と `-c core.attributesFile=/dev/null -c core.sshCommand=false` を付け、PR 側の `.gitattributes`（external diff、textconv、filter）が検査内容や実行物を変えないようにする。Python は `-I`。PATH 探索で実行するものは無い。 A shell script that runs under a PR-controlled or worker-controlled environment (verdict.sh, the chain glue, CI steps) is executed as a program with `#!/bin/bash -p`, never as `bash <file>`, and only by a trusted parent that supplies the clean environment before the exec: `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<passwd home> LANG=C.UTF-8 /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -p <absolute script path> …` (long options before `-p`). Privileged mode discards inherited functions, `BASH_ENV`/`ENV`, `SHELLOPTS`, `BASHOPTS`, `CDPATH` and `GLOBIGNORE`, but on Linux an inherited `LD_PRELOAD`/`LD_AUDIT` already executes while the loader maps `/bin/bash`, before `-p` or any statement runs, so a self re-exec inside the script is not a boundary and re-executing `"$0"` would reopen the caller's pathname (a worker-owned symlink can be swapped between the two executions); the program therefore verifies and refuses instead of repairing: its environment must consist of exactly the allowed names (checked through absolute paths `/usr/bin/env`, `/usr/bin/grep`), `$0` resolved with `realpath` must be a regular file under the repository root, and HOME must equal the passwd home of the real uid (`/usr/bin/dscl . -read /Users/<user> NFSHomeDirectory` on macOS, `/usr/bin/getent passwd <uid>` on Linux), otherwise exit 2 with a named message. A caller-set sentinel variable is not a sanitization proof, because the caller controls it (ci-efficiency a04 and verdict a04 C-80 reviews, 2026-10-19). No script accepts a caller-supplied executable directory; interpreters are the fixed absolute paths item 9 names.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-verdict-audit-pool-a04-text-security-12b9ebf.md:2689:3. **信頼パスの境界検査** 仕組みが信頼するパス（スクリプト、台帳、証跡、worktree、lock、出力先）は realpath で解決し、`.claude/worktrees/` または manifest の worker ルート配下なら拒否（ask/hold）。symlink 構成要素は解決後に比較し、大小文字を区別しないファイルシステムでは同一性比較を大小文字非依存で行う。 A validator or scanner enumerates its inputs by walking the filesystem under fixed roots (every regular file, ignored or untracked included), never by asking git which files exist: `git ls-files` trusts the index and the working-tree `.gitignore` rules, which a same-UID writer edits without a commit (a07 C-80 rounds 1 to 3, 2026-10-19); git is consulted only to confirm the root (`--show-toplevel` equality with a real `.git` directory) and never as an exclusion authority.

.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-worker-write-boundary-a01-text-security-519afd7.md:2054:- 2026-10-19T03:24:11Z: C-80 review of the text (`.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-worker-write-boundary-a01-text-security-8bac9e5.md`): `Verdict: incorrect`, seven P1, one P2: (1) the gh wrapper forwards argv verbatim, so `gh repo clone … -- --config core.sshCommand=<exe>` runs worker code outside the sandbox → the wrapper allows an explicit subcommand list and refuses `--` passthrough and config-carrying forms; (2) a bash wrapper reads BASH_ENV before `env -i` (probe confirmed) → the wrapper is Python under an absolute `-I` interpreter path rendered from the trusted root; (3) project hooks execute the worktree's `.claude/hooks/contextdb_hook.py` through bare `python3` and the format hooks resolve tools through shims → worker seats run no project hooks (a factual check of the settings switch is pending with the Claude Code docs); (4) Codex workers share `.git/objects` and `.git/refs` writes (herdr-agents:439), so `origin/main` can be replaced after a fetch → design 5.14 item 8 now binds the committed ledger to the sha `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` returns (amended 03:2xZ); (5) `git ls-tree` enumeration needs the sanitized git environment; (6) the reviewer states Edit deny rules also enter the Bash sandbox configuration, which would block the orchestrator's sandboxed record writes under `.orchestration/**` → a factual check pending; (7) `failIfUnavailable: false` lets a seat run unsandboxed when Linux dependencies are missing → `true` for worker seats; (8) P2: symlink and case-alias identity tests missing. Five facts are being verified against the Claude Code documentation before the revision (excludedCommands matching, hooks switches and capture, Edit denies vs sandbox, failIfUnavailable, Edit rule scope and path forms).
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-worker-write-boundary-a01-text-security-519afd7.md:2056:- 2026-10-19T03:35:17Z: the revised P1-15 text (prompt `p115-a01r-redesign-prompt.md`, 320 lines) installed: the Claude-seat boundary as the user-level PreToolUse hook `executable_worker-write-boundary.py` (session-cwd classification, canonical target checks), `failIfUnavailable: true`, the Python `-I` gh-trusted wrapper with a subcommand allowlist, the committed ledger at the ls-remote sha, per-seat caches; checker OK; the second C-80 review started 03:38Z.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-worker-write-boundary-a01-text-security-519afd7.md:2057:- 2026-10-19T03:42:19Z: C-80 second review of the P1-15 text (`…-text-security-67415f5.md`): `Verdict: incorrect`, seven P1: the hook classifies by the mutable event cwd (a worker can cd out) → classify by CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; project hooks execute worker-writable scripts (`scripts/agent-stop-gate.sh`, `.claude/hooks/*.py`, PATH-resolved prettier with worker config) → hooks move out of the tracked `.claude/settings.json` into generated local settings, worker seats get a minimal trusted hook set; `python -I` does not neutralize LD_PRELOAD on Linux for the excluded wrapper → the outside-sandbox gh path is abandoned if gh can run inside the sandbox (CA trust experiment 03:4xZ); `gh pr create` runs git against the caller repository without the git controls → moot when gh is sandboxed; `refs/replace` redirects `git show <sha>` → `--no-replace-objects` (5.14 item 8); a worker's own sandboxed background child can swap a validated path before the unsandboxed file-tool write → stated as the residual it is; the hook lacks a failure policy → every error path exits 2 (fail-closed) with tests.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-worker-write-boundary-a01-text-security-519afd7.md:2059:- 2026-10-19T03:53:27Z: the round-3 P1-15 text (prompt `p115-a01r2-redesign-prompt.md`, 333 lines) installed: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR classification, the orchestrator-only guard for project hooks (.claude/settings.json joins), no unsandboxed worker command (gh * leaves excludedCommands, Codex network inside the sandbox, the permgate codex rule as the operator step), --no-replace-objects at the ls-remote sha, fail-closed hook (exit 2), the worker race stated as a residual; checker OK; the third C-80 review started 03:54Z.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-worker-write-boundary-a01-text-security-519afd7.md:2060:- 2026-10-19T03:58:10Z: C-80 third review of the P1-15 text (`…-text-security-ecc7ab5.md`): `Verdict: incorrect`, five P1: (1) a sandboxed worker can swap an allowed directory for a symlink after the hook validated, so the unsandboxed file tool overwrites a trusted path (the race is an escape, not a self-harm); (2) the writable object database defeats sha pinning: a replaced intermediate tree object redirects `git show <sha>:path` to an attacker blob (tree traversal does not re-hash intermediate objects); (3) hook descendants still resolve `python3` and `env bash` through shims (herdr-agent-state.sh, delivery scripts); (4) the Herdr unix socket in the worker sandbox lets a sandboxed client request host execution (`pane run`) through the server; (5) a hook timeout or kill is fail-open unless the per-hook `onFailure: "block"` (Claude Code ≥ 2.1.295) is set.

.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-worker-write-boundary-a01-text-security-519afd7.md:2063:- 2026-10-19T04:15:38Z: C-80 fourth review of the P1-15 text (`…-text-security-8d42532.md`): `Verdict: incorrect`, six P1: (1) workers share the orchestrator's gh credential, so a worker can merge through the API inside the sandbox (GitHub cannot distinguish seats) → D-024-22: a dedicated worker GitHub identity outside the ruleset bypass list (operator step); (2) the deny inventory from `git ls-tree` trusts the writable object store (replace refs) → a static rendered list; (3) the orchestrator cache `.agents/worklog/uv-cache` is missing from the inventory → listed; (4) `~/.agents/**` deny conflicts with the agmsg store writes → a narrower list; (5) linked-worktree sessions load the main checkout's `.claude/settings.local.json` (documented), so worktree-local worker settings are not read and the orchestrator's local hooks run in worker sessions → the guard covers them and worker hooks live in the worker config dir; (6) upstream agmsg scripts carry `/usr/bin/env bash` shebangs → the hook command pins PATH=/usr/bin:/bin. Design 5.14 items 0 and 1 amended; round 5 of the text follows.
.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-worker-write-boundary-a01-text-security-519afd7.md:2064:- 2026-10-19T04:22:08Z: the round-5 P1-15 text (prompt `p115-a01r4-redesign-prompt.md`, 439 lines) installed: the worker gh identity (D-024-22) as a Files item with the worker gh configuration directory and the operator steps; a static `trusted_paths` inventory in the manifest; narrow home-path denies that leave the agmsg store writable; worker hooks in the worker configuration directory because linked-worktree sessions load the main checkout's settings.local.json; the orchestrator's local hooks behind the guard; PATH=/usr/bin:/bin pinned on every hook command; "reduces" wording where item 0 applies; checker OK; the fifth C-80 review started 04:22Z.

.orchestration/validation/dotfiles-T133-worker-write-boundary-a01-text-security-519afd7.md:2845:1. **書き込み境界（前提 6、ランタイム別に正直に）** Claude worker 席は専用の設定ディレクトリ `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-worker`（chezmoi が描画、operator が一度 login）で起動し、orchestrator の `~/.claude` と設定を共有しない。worker 設定：除外コマンド無し、Herdr socket 無し、sandbox の allowWrite は自席 worktree と agmsg store と席別キャッシュだけ、`failIfUnavailable: true`、信頼パス（anchored checkout の `.claude/worktrees/` 以外、`~/.agents`、`~/.claude*`、`~/.local`、`~/.config`）への Edit deny（公式文書：file tool の permission 検査は要求パスと symlink 解決後のパスの両方に deny を適用し、symlink そのものへの書き込みは拒否する）、sandbox の強制範囲はユーザー設定ではなく **managed settings**（`/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、公式文書 "Repository settings under an admin-required sandbox"：project/local 設定は sandbox を無効化したり除外・socket を足したりできない）に置く。chezmoi は user ではこのファイルを書けないので、描画した内容を操作者が `sudo` で一度配置する（操作者手順）。worker 設定は worktree 自身の `.claude/**` と `.mcp.json` への Edit deny（`//<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/*/.claude/**`）を持つ（Bash 側は sandbox 既定の settings/hooks の denyWithinAllow）。agmsg store（全席が書く）から配送 hook が driver や plugin を source する上流の経路（storage.sh の `drivers.partition` traversal、`db/trusted-plugins` と `plugins/partition/shared.sh` による差し替え承認）は別タスク（agmsg hardening）の行で、worker 設定は `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/plugins/**` と `~/.agents/skills/agmsg/db/trusted-plugins` への書き込みを deny し（Edit deny は sandbox の deny にも合流する）、hook 側は store 由来の設定値を検証するまで残余と書く。managed settings の配置先は OS で異なる（macOS `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、Linux `/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json`）。hook は agmsg 配送だけを、hook コマンドを `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<home> …` で始めて（`BASH_ENV` などの継承環境を bash 起動前に消す；PATH 固定だけでは BASH_ENV が先に走る）絶対パスのインタプリタで呼び（上流の agmsg スクリプトは `/usr/bin/env bash` の shebang を持つので、hook 実行環境の PATH が shim を含まないことで束縛する）、各 hook に `onFailure: "block"`。公式文書：linked worktree の session は **main checkout の `.claude/settings.local.json` を読む**ので、worker 向けの hook を worktree の settings.local.json に書いても読まれず、逆に orchestrator の local hooks が worker session でも走る。したがって orchestrator 側の local hooks も guard 経由にし、worker 側の hook は worker config dir の settings に置く。Edit deny の一覧は `git ls-tree` ではなく描画時の静的一覧（manifest に列挙、`.agents/worklog/**` と `.agents/worklog/uv-cache/**` を含む）とし、`~/.agents/**` の全面 deny は agmsg store の書き込みと矛盾するので、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.agents/skills/**/scripts/**`、`~/.agents/model-profiles.env` などストア以外を列挙する。公式文書で確認した事実（2026-10-19）：`Edit(path)` の deny は Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit にも効き、deny → ask → allow の順で最初の一致が決まる；ただし Read/Edit の deny は **Bash sandbox の設定にも合流する**（"Paths and domains from both sandbox settings and permission rules are merged into the final sandbox configuration"）ので、ユーザー設定（全席共有）に `.orchestration/**` の Edit deny を書くと orchestrator の Bash による記録書き込みも止まる。hook は起動時に固定されず、設定ファイルの編集は file watcher が即座に反映する。`sandbox.failIfUnavailable` の既定は fail-open（依存が無ければ sandbox 無しで実行）。したがって Claude 席の境界は Edit deny 規則ではなく、**ユーザーレベルの PreToolUse hook**（`~/.claude/hooks/worker-write-boundary`、chezmoi が描画、`/bin/sh` または絶対パスの `python3 -I`）で作る：cwd の realpath が `<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/` 配下の session では、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit の対象が cwd の外、または `<cwd>/.claude/**`・`<cwd>/.mcp.json` のとき `permissionDecision: deny` を返す。Bash 側は sandbox の既定 `denyWithinAllow`（settings、hooks）と `allowWrite`（自席 worktree）が担う。`failIfUnavailable: true` を全席に置く。 Codex 席は sandbox（workspace-write）がツールの書き込み全部を自席の worktree と列挙パスに限る。Claude 席は Seatbelt sandbox が Bash を限るだけで、Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit、hook、MCP プロセスは sandbox 外で動き、permission policy（permgate の決定論ポリシー）が path で拒否しない限り anchored checkout や `~/.agents` にも書ける（2026-10-19 時点、描画済み設定にその deny は無い）。したがって前提 6 は「Codex 席は成立、Claude 席は P1-15 が描画設定に Edit の path deny を入れるまで残余」と書く。P1-15 以前に「worker は信頼ルートに書けない」と書く文は誤りで、C-80 が拒否する。P1-15 が入るまで、承認の出所は項目 8 の「コミット済み台帳」で守る。書き込みは自席の worktree（`.claude/worktrees/<name>`）、scratch、列挙されたツールキャッシュに限る。anchored checkout（`.claude/worktrees/` 以外）、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.claude/hooks`、信頼ルートのバイナリ、orchestrator の証跡・スナップショット・lock は worker から書けない。render テストが描画後の deny を検証する。残余は「どの席 sandbox にも属さない同一 UID プロセス」と、Worker Playbook step 4 が sandbox 外に出す少数のコマンド（gh）。後者は D-024-17（P1-15）で絶対パスの実行体に束縛する。

def policy(root, base, head, t):
    """Return (the policy bytes, its front matter or None, whether the base's dispatched text is the policy)."""
    dispatched = show(root, base, f".orchestration/tasks/{t}.md")
    data = show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/task.md") if dispatched is None else dispatched
    return data, front(data), dispatched is not None


def checker(root, data):
    """Return the base checker's violations on the base's dispatched bytes: it hands the text's literals to git (C8 to
    C10) and opens its design path (C6), so a pull request's own text never reaches it (worker review P0 of bcbd6949)."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
        cmd = [*CHECKER_RUN, "--root", root, str(Path(scratch, "task.md"))]
        Path(cmd[-1]).write_bytes(data)
        run = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    out = run.stdout.splitlines()  # the file is task.md, so C1 compares task_id with `task`; task-id checks <t>
    # only the checker's own verdict line with its exit code counts; a crash also exits 1, with no verdict line
    if (out[:1], run.returncode) not in ((["task.md: OK"], 0), (["task.md: FAIL"], 1)):
        return [("checker", f"no verdict (exit {run.returncode}): {(run.stdout + run.stderr).strip()[-300:]}")]
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in out[1:] if ln.strip()]
    return [("checker", ln) for ln in lines if not re.fullmatch(r"C1 task_id .* != file task", ln)]


def check_task(root, base, head, t, changed, numstat):
    """Return (violations, warnings) for one task, each violation a (rule, detail) pair."""
    copy_path = f".orchestration/{t}/task.md"
    copy = show(root, head, copy_path)
    if (fm := front(copy)) is None:
        return [("front-matter", f"{copy_path} is unreadable or has no front matter mapping")], []
    data, rules, dispatched = policy(root, base, head, t)
    if rules is None:
        return [("front-matter", f"the base's .orchestration/tasks/{t}.md has no front matter mapping")], []
    found, warnings = [], []
    if fm.get("task_id") != t:
        found.append(("task-id", f"the copy's task_id {fm.get('task_id')!r} is not its directory {t}"))
    result = show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/result.txt")
    result_text = result.decode(errors="replace") if result is not None else ""
    if dispatched:
        if data != copy:
            found.append(("task-copy", f"{copy_path} differs from the base's dispatched .orchestration/tasks/{t}.md"))
    else:  # the copy's own policy is provisional: a head file or a result.txt token is a claim, never authentication
        unverifiable = "task copy unverifiable (no dispatched text at base)"
        found += [("task-copy", unverifiable)] if os.environ.get("REGIME_REQUIRE_DISPATCHED") == "1" else []
        warnings += [] if os.environ.get("REGIME_REQUIRE_DISPATCHED") == "1" else [unverifiable]
        warnings.append("checker skipped: the copy is unverifiable, and the base's checker reads only the base's text")
        if result is not None and token(result_text, "task_copy") != sha256(copy):
            found.append(
                ("task-copy", f"sha256 {sha256(copy)} is not result.txt's task_copy={token(result_text, 'task_copy')}")
            )
    found += checker(root, data) if dispatched else []
    exempt = tuple(f".orchestration/{p}/" for p in rules.get("reset_of") or [] if isinstance(p, str))
    bound = precheck(root, head, t, result_text, exempt)
    if bound is None:
        warnings.append("precheck absent")
    found += [("precheck", detail) for detail in bound or []]
    entries = [a for a in rules.get("allowed_files") or [] if isinstance(a, str)]
    found += [
        ("allowed-files", f"{p} is outside allowed_files")
        for p in changed
        if not p.startswith(exempt) and not any(allowed(p, a) for a in entries)
    ]
    exceeded, cap_warnings = caps(data.decode(errors="replace"), numstat)
    found += [("caps", detail) for detail in exceeded]
    return found, warnings + cap_warnings


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--base", required=True, help="the base ref, such as origin/main")
    parser.add_argument("--head", required=True, help="the pull request's head commit")
    parser.add_argument("--root", help="the base checkout (default: the current git toplevel)")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    root = args.root or git(".", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").stdout.decode().strip() or "."
    shas = [
        git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", f"{r}^{{commit}}").stdout.decode().strip()
        for r in (args.base, args.head)
    ]
    if not all(shas):
        print(f"regime-ci: cannot resolve --base {args.base} or --head {args.head} in {root}")
        return 2
    base, head = shas
    at = git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.decode().strip()  # the verifier and the checker must be the base's
    if at != base:
        print(
            f"regime-ci: checkout: {root} is at {at[:12]}, not the base {base[:12]}, so the code run would not be the base's"
        )
        return 1
    try:
        changed = listed(root, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", f"{base}...{head}")
        numstat = []
        for row in listed(root, "diff", "--numstat", "--no-renames", f"{base}...{head}"):
            added, deleted, path = row.split("\t", 2)  # a path may hold a tab; a binary file counts 0 lines
            numstat.append((int(added) if added.isdigit() else 0, int(deleted) if deleted.isdigit() else 0, path))
    except GitError as error:
        print(f"regime-ci: {error}")
        return 2
    for path in sorted(set(changed) & set(RUNS)):
        print(
            f"regime-ci: warning: the diff changes {path}; this run executed the base's version, the audit reads the change"
        )
    dirs = sorted({m.group(1) for p in changed if (m := re.match(r"\.orchestration/([^/]+)/", p))})
    targets = [t for t in dirs if show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/task.md") is not None]
    if not targets:
        stray = [p for p in changed if not p.startswith(".orchestration/")]
        if not stray:  # content alone decides: a branch name is the pull request's own claim
            print("regime-ci: no target (records-only)")
            return 0
        print(
            f"regime-ci: no target: {len(stray)} changed path(s) outside .orchestration/ and no task copy, first {stray[0]}"
        )
        return 1
    # Amendment 1: a later copy whose reset_of names an earlier one is the lineage's only target, when both verify
    policies = {t: policy(root, base, head, t) for t in targets}
    exact = {t: policies[t][2] and show(root, head, f".orchestration/{t}/task.md") == policies[t][0] for t in targets}
    later = {
        p: t
        for t, (_, rules, _) in policies.items()
        for p in (rules or {}).get("reset_of") or []
        if p in policies and p != t and exact[t] and exact[p]  # both head copies equal their base texts
    }
    for p, t in sorted(later.items()):
        print(f"regime-ci: warning: {p}: predecessor copy .orchestration/{p}/task.md (reset_of of {t})")
    targets = [t for t in targets if t not in later]
    failed = False
    for t in targets:
        try:
            found, warnings = check_task(root, base, head, t, changed, numstat)
        except GitError as error:
            found, warnings = [("git", str(error))], []
        for detail in warnings:
            print(f"regime-ci: warning: {t}: {detail}")
        for rule, detail in found:
            print(f"regime-ci: {t}: {rule}: {detail}")
        failed |= bool(found)
    if not failed:
        print(f"regime-ci: ok {len(targets)} task(s)")
    return int(failed)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
name: regime

# The regime job (plan 024 P1-11, redesigned in T133 regime-ci a02): a pull request that carries a task copy is checked
# by the base's scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py against the base's dispatched policy. pull_request_target runs this
# workflow as it is on the base; the pull request's head is fetched as data and is never checked out or executed.
# It is an optional check until the operator adds `regime` to the ruleset's required contexts.
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

concurrency:
  group: regime-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  regime:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # The base branch's tip at run time: the event's recorded base sha can lag the branch (on PR #420 it was the
          # head's fork point, from before this verifier; ci:39185982423:1). The pull request cannot move this branch.
          ref: refs/heads/${{ github.base_ref }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c18668ad3cf93ea998bef934396af7bb5c839dc7 # v10.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
      - name: Fetch the pull request's head as data
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/pull/${PR_NUMBER}/head:refs/regime/pr-head"
          test "$(git rev-parse refs/regime/pr-head)" = "${HEAD_SHA}"
      - name: Check the pull request with the base's verifier
        env:
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: uv run --no-config --no-project --with pyyaml python -I scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py --base "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --head "${HEAD_SHA}"
"""Exercise regime-ci.py on temporary repositories (a base with the dispatched text, a head with its copy) and regime.yml."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CHECKER = "scripts/orchestrator/task-consistency-check.py"
VERIFIER = "scripts/orchestrator/regime-ci.py"
UV = [
    shutil.which("uv") or "uv",
    "run",
    "--no-config",
    "--no-project",
    "--with",
    "pyyaml",
    "python",
    "-I",
]  # as regime.yml
T = "t1-a01"
RESIDUAL = '"residual: the fixture row is test data for this control"'
ROWS = "".join(
    f"  - control: {name}\n    disposition: {RESIDUAL}\n"
    for name in (
        "the PR edits src/tool.sh",
        "the PR edits tests/unit/test_tool.py",
        f"the evidence under .orchestration/{T}/",
        "task metadata",
        "metadata separators",
        "in-process effects",
        "workflow and interpreter or environment inputs",
        "new or renamed scripts",
        "orchestrator effect merge",
        "orchestrator effect update-branch",
        "orchestrator effect forced worker removal",
    )
)
TASK = (
    f"---\nformat: 2\ntask_id: {T}\nkind: code\nsecurity: false\nallowed_files:\n  - src/tool.sh\n"
    f"  - tests/unit/test_tool.py\n  - .orchestration/{T}/**\nthreat_table:\n{ROWS}premises: []\n---\n\n# {T}\n\n"
    "## Check\n\nat most 3 changed lines outside `tests/` and `.orchestration/`, 2 under `tests/`.\n"
)
CODE = {"src/tool.sh": "a\nb\nc\n", "tests/unit/test_tool.py": "x = 1\ny = 2\n"}
SKIPPED = f"regime-ci: warning: {T}: checker skipped: the copy is unverifiable, and the base's checker reads only the base's text"
GIT_ENV = {f"GIT_{role}_{k}": v for role in ("AUTHOR", "COMMITTER") for k, v in (("NAME", "t"), ("EMAIL", "t@t"))}


class RegimeCiTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "GITHUB_HEAD_REF"}
        self.env = env | GIT_ENV | {"GITHUB_HEAD_REF": "tools/t1"}

    def git(self, *args):
        cmd = ["git", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", *args]
        return subprocess.run(
            cmd, cwd=self.repo, env=self.env, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
        ).stdout.strip()

    def commit(self, files, message):
        for rel, text in files.items():  # None deletes the file
            (self.repo / rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (self.repo / rel).unlink() if text is None else (self.repo / rel).write_text(text)
        self.git("add", "-A")
        self.git("commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", message)
        return self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD")

    def build(
        self, copy=TASK, dispatched=TASK, code=None, precheck_head=None, precheck_token=None, evidence=True, **more
    ):
        """A base commit (the checker, the dispatched text), then a code commit and an evidence commit on a branch.

        more: `late` files committed after the code commit precheck.json names, `precheck_doc` as precheck.json's text,
        `task_copy` as result.txt's token, `checker` as the base's checker, `base` as more base files, `branch` as the
        head branch; precheck_head "side" names a commit on another branch. The base also holds the verifier, the
        checkout returns to the base, and the base's verifier runs against the head commit (a02).
        """
        temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temp.cleanup)
        self.repo = Path(temp.name).resolve()
        self.git("init", "-q", "-b", "main")
        base = {CHECKER: more.get("checker") or (ROOT / CHECKER).read_text(), "README": "base\n"} | more.get("base", {})
        base |= {VERIFIER: (ROOT / VERIFIER).read_text()}
        self.commit(base | ({f".orchestration/tasks/{T}.md": dispatched} if dispatched else {}), "base")
        self.git("update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/main", "HEAD")  # the checker's C8 to C10 probe origin/main
        if precheck_head == "side":
            precheck_head = self.commit({"side.txt": "side\n"}, "side")
            self.git("reset", "-q", "--hard", "HEAD~1")
        self.git("switch", "-q", "-c", more.get("branch", "pr"))
        code_head = self.commit(CODE if code is None else code, "code")
        if "late" in more:
            self.commit(more["late"], "a change after the precheck")
        if evidence:
            pre = more.get("precheck_doc") or json.dumps({"head": precheck_head or code_head})
            token = precheck_token or hashlib.sha256(pre.encode()).hexdigest()
            copy_token = more.get("task_copy") or hashlib.sha256(copy.encode()).hexdigest()
            result = f"AGMSG-RESULT v1 task_id={T} precheck={token} task_copy={copy_token}\n"
            files = {f".orchestration/{T}/task.md": copy}
            if precheck_head != "absent":
                files |= {f".orchestration/{T}/precheck.json": pre, f".orchestration/{T}/result.txt": result}
            self.commit(files, "evidence")
        self.head = self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
        self.git("switch", "-q", "main")
        return self.regime()

    def head_commit(self, files, message):
        """Commit on the head branch and return the checkout to the base."""
        self.git("switch", "-q", "pr")
        self.head = self.commit(files, message)
        self.git("switch", "-q", "main")

    def regime(self, head=None, **env):
        cmd = [*UV, str(self.repo / VERIFIER), "--base", "main", "--head", head or self.head, "--root", str(self.repo)]
        return subprocess.run(
            cmd, cwd=self.repo, env=self.env | env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120, check=False
        )

    def test_regime_ci_reads_the_head_as_data_and_runs_the_base_verifier(self):
        # Bot P1 4308651010 and 4308651011 (a02 items 5, 6): the head rewrites the verifier and the checker into programs
        # that pass and leave markers, and forges a dispatched text with a matching result token; the base's policy,
        # verifier and checker still decide, the checkout stays at the base, and no head program runs.
        fake = 'import pathlib\npathlib.Path("head-program-ran").write_text("x")\nprint("{line}")\n'
        scripts = {VERIFIER: fake.format(line="regime-ci: ok 1 task(s)"), CHECKER: fake.format(line="task.md: OK")}
        rows = "".join(f"  - control: the PR edits {path}\n    disposition: {RESIDUAL}\n" for path in scripts)
        policy = TASK.replace("threat_table:\n", "threat_table:\n" + rows).replace("at most 3 ", "at most 999 ")
        policy = policy.replace("  - src/tool.sh\n", "  - src/tool.sh\n" + "".join(f"  - {path}\n" for path in scripts))
        forged = policy.replace("  - src/tool.sh\n", "  - src/tool.sh\n  - stray.sh\n")
        cases = (  # head changes, expected exit, the violation's phrase
            (CODE | scripts, 0, None),
            (CODE | scripts | {"stray.sh": "x\n"}, 1, "allowed-files: stray.sh is outside allowed_files"),
            (CODE | scripts | {"stray.sh": "x\n", f".orchestration/tasks/{T}.md": forged}, 1, "task-copy: "),

# AGMSG-TASK dotfiles-T133-regime-ci-followup-a01 — the P1-11 lineage's owner task (advisory P2 of PR #418)

Written 2026-10-18 by the orchestrator seat before the first advisory disposition of PR #418 (C-51: the owner task exists before the first advisory row). It owns the advisory rows recorded under `## Owned by dotfiles-T133-regime-ci-followup-a01` in `.orchestration/acceptance/dotfiles-T133-regime-ci-a02.md` (plan 020 step 1.2; the a01 record holds the S1 class table); it is dispatched after PR #418 merges, to a seat the orchestrator names.

## Item 1

The new authenticated API dependency breaks the existing regime CI caller, and two coverage gaps allow incomplete threat tables to pass. Targeted read-only probes confirmed these issues; the full test suite was not run.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Supply authentication for regime CI's new API calls — scripts/orchestrator/task-consistency-check.py:182-182
  After this checker lands on main, `.github/workflows/regime.yml` invokes it through `regime-ci.py` without setting `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN`. Fresh runners have no GitHub CLI login, so tasks referencing a design or requiring C8/C9 lookups now fail: unauthenticated `gh api` exits 4, and regime-ci reports `no verdict`. Supply the workflow token alongside this change and cover that caller environment in a regression test.

- [P2] Require a separate row for overlapping directory scopes — scripts/orchestrator/task-consistency-check.py:348-350
  With both `scripts/` and `scripts/orchestrator/task-consistency-check.py` allowed, a table containing only the child file's row passes. This prefix check credits that row to the directory, while the new `hits()` logic correctly credits it only to the child; consequently, nothing requires a row controlling the rest of `scripts/`. Validate coverage against each entry's own row, preserving the one-row-per-entry requirement in [AGENTS.md:78](AGENTS.md#L78).

- [P2] Classify Claude instruction shims as applied files — scripts/orchestrator/task-consistency-check.py:476-480
  For an allowed `*.md` scope, adding a concrete row for `AGENTS.md` makes C12 pass even without a row for the existing `CLAUDE.md`. That file controls Claude's instruction import and recovery behavior, as established by [AGENTS.md:5–6](AGENTS.md#L5-L6), so it is not ordinary documentation. Scoped instruction files such as `vendor/compactiondb/AGENTS.md` are likewise missed. Include these instruction files in applied-file classification so wildcard scopes require concrete threat rows.

Two findings in head `2cb584823ccf5f22069ea925b252d8cefb020844`:

- **P2 · High confidence — `scripts/orchestrator/task-consistency-check.py:476`:** C12 classifies only the resolved target, allowing an unnamed applied symlink such as `scripts/run → tests/fixtures/payload.txt` through a wildcard scope without a concrete threat row, although invoking the link can execute its target.
- **P2 · High confidence — `scripts/orchestrator/task-consistency-check.py:251`:** The missing-literal shortcut returns before examining directory symlinks, so `scripts/link/new.py`, with `link` pointing elsewhere inside the repository, bypasses the claimed rejection of internal directory aliases.

Both reproduced with the checked-in functions and in-memory filesystem models, without writes. The first returned no findings for a `.txt` target; changing its target to an applied `.py` file correctly produced C12. The second returned no findings for a missing file beneath an internal directory alias. These gaps undermine the threat table’s path-identity/classification controls and its **closed** “internal directory aliases” row. Classification should consider both the enumerated applied path and its confined target; prefix validation must precede the missing-file shortcut.

The remaining controls revealed no additional findings: C14 uses digest authorization and fixed operations without shell execution; YAML uses safe loading; canonical reads bind repository, host and validated commit; credentials travel through child environments. Unicode/collision and C16 controls were inspected. Parent execution, shared caches and same-UID interference remain disclosed residual risks.

Source/test hashes and the task-copy hash match their evidence records. No files were changed.

Not rerun: full suites, native filesystem fixtures or live CI; GitHub connectivity failed. The two demonstrated path-validation bypasses remain unresolved.

xit 70、helper task RESULT）ため、同じディレクトリサービスを libc 経由で読む `/usr/bin/id -P | cut -d: -f9`（macOS）/ `getent passwd "$(id -un)" | cut -d: -f6`（Linux）/ Python の 
`pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir` を passwd home の読み方とする。項目の意図（HOME は passwd のもの、継承値ではない）は不変。

orchestrator 側の仕組み（merge gate、integrate-merge、orch-gate、dispositions、audit-pool、verdict、chain）は、同じホスト上で同じ UID の worker プロセスと共存する。2026-10-19 の C-

を参照で適用し、本節の各項目に対応する threat 行を持つ。文ごとに言い換えない。

ication Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json`、公式文書 "Repository settings under an admin-required sandbox"：project/local 設定は sandbox を無効化したり除外・socket を足した
りできない）に置く。chezmoi は user ではこのファイルを書けないので、描画した内容を操作者が `sudo` で一度配置する（操作者手順）。worker 設定は worktree 自身の `.claude/**` と `.mcp.
json` への Edit deny（`//<anchored>/.claude/worktrees/*/.claude/**`）を持つ（Bash 側は sandbox 既定の settings/hooks の denyWithinAllow）。agmsg store（全席が書く）から配送 hook が

を含まないことで束縛する）、各 hook に `onFailure: "block"`。公式文書：linked worktree の session は **main checkout の `.claude/settings.local.json` を読む**ので、worker 向けの ho
ok を worktree の settings.local.json に書いても読まれず、逆に orchestrator の local hooks が worker session でも走る。したがって orchestrator 側の local hooks も guard 経由にし、w
orker 側の hook は worker config dir の settings に置く。Edit deny の一覧は `git ls-tree` ではなく描画時の静的一覧（manifest に列挙、`.agents/worklog/**` と `.agents/worklog/uv-cac

ktrees/` 以外）、`~/.agents/agent-config.yaml`、`~/.claude/hooks`、信頼ルートのバイナリ、orchestrator の証跡・スナップショット・lock は worker から書けない。render テストが描画後の

体に束縛する。 The protected-path inventory a seat's Edit denies cover is enumerated from the inputs of every trusted executable, not only the executables: it includes `~/.agents/p
ermgate-policy.yaml` (permgate rereads it for every decision), `~/.local/lib/python*/site-packages` and every other user-site or startup-hook location of the interpreters in use (`
.pth`, `usercustomize.py`, `sitecustomize.py`), `~/.claude-worker`'s hook and settings files, and the rendered guard; a text that binds an executable names its inputs in the same i
nventory (P1-15 amendment 5 C-80, 2026-10-19). The inventory of executable configuration sources a worker start screens is the documented loading list of the installed Claude Code 
version, enumerated once from the documentation (settings: user, project, local and managed `settings.json`; project `.mcp.json`; the configuration directory's global state `.claud
e.json` with user-scoped and project-local MCP servers; plugins and skills directories (`.claude/skills/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, enabled plugins); hook handlers of every docu
mented type (`command`, `http` and any other `type` value the hooks reference lists: a handler is an executable input whether it names a command or a URL, and a worker start refuse
s every handler type but `command`), `apiKeyHelper`, `statusLine.command`, MCP server commands), and the launcher screens or disables every source before accepting workspace trust,
 refusing any executable payload it did not write; adding sources one review at a time is the anti-pattern (P1-15 a02 reviews 2ae9e2c and ebbb71b, 2026-10-19). The enumeration quot
es the documentation's values (the page, its fetched_at and the listed values) in the text's premises so a reviewer can check them against the live page; naming a source by one of

2. **無害化した環境を最初に** 最初の処理として `env -i` に入り、PATH は信頼ルートで解決した絶対バイナリへのリンクだけの私設ディレクトリ（shims、空、相対は拒否）。git は毎回 `GIT_CO
NFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.fsmonitor=false -c protocol.allow=never -c protocol.https.allow=always` と明示 `-C`（https だけ許す
。`protocol.allow=never` 単独は必要な fetch を止める）。 検査の読み取りは `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1` で部分クローンの遅延 fetch（checkout 設定の credential.helper を起動しうる）を止め、
`-c submodule.recurse=false --ignore-submodules=all` で submodule 内の status/diff（submodule 自身の設定が filter を有効化しうる）を止める。`.gitmodules` を持つ checkout は検査対象
として拒否する。 `-C` は作業木を束縛しないので（repo-local の `core.worktree` が読み先を checkout 外へ向けられる）、git は `--git-dir=<checkout>/.git --work-tree=<checkout>` を明示
し、`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` の realpath が checkout と一致しないときは拒否する。 premise や検査の「コマンド実行」は、固定語彙の読み取り専用プローブ（`git rev-parse <ref>`、
`test -e <path>`、`grep -c <pattern> <file>` のように検査器自身が解釈する形）だけを許し、任意のシェル文字列は実行しない（本文のハッシュはコマンド文を認証するだけで、`python -I scri
pts/x.py` のファイル被演算子や `source ./x.sh` の中身は認証しない）。diff と show は `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv` と `-c core.attributesFile=/dev/null -c core.sshCommand=false` を
付け、PR 側の `.gitattributes`（external diff、textconv、filter）が検査内容や実行物を変えないようにする。Python は `-I`。PATH 探索で実行するものは無い。 A shell script that runs un
der a PR-controlled or worker-controlled environment (verdict.sh, the chain glue, CI steps) is executed as a program with `#!/bin/bash -p`, never as `bash <file>`, and only by a tr
usted parent that supplies the clean environment before the exec: `/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<passwd home> LANG=C.UTF-8 /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -p <absolute scri
pt path> …` (long options before `-p`). Privileged mode discards inherited functions, `BASH_ENV`/`ENV`, `SHELLOPTS`, `BASHOPTS`, `CDPATH` and `GLOBIGNORE`, but on Linux an inherite
d `LD_PRELOAD`/`LD_AUDIT` already executes while the loader maps `/bin/bash`, before `-p` or any statement runs, so a self re-exec inside the script is not a boundary and re-execut
ing `"$0"` would reopen the caller's pathname (a worker-owned symlink can be swapped between the two executions); the program therefore verifies and refuses instead of repairing: i
ts environment must consist of exactly the allowed names (checked through absolute paths `/usr/bin/env`, `/usr/bin/grep`), `$0` resolved with `realpath` must be a regular file unde
r the repository root, and HOME must equal the passwd home of the real uid (`/usr/bin/dscl . -read /Users/<user> NFSHomeDirectory` on macOS, `/usr/bin/getent passwd <uid>` on Linux
), otherwise exit 2 with a named message. A caller-set sentinel variable is not a sanitization proof, because the caller controls it (ci-efficiency a04 and verdict a04 C-80 reviews
, 2026-10-19). No script accepts a caller-supplied executable directory; interpreters are the fixed absolute paths item 9 names.
3. **信頼パスの境界検査** 仕組みが信頼するパス（スクリプト、台帳、証跡、worktree、lock、出力先）は realpath で解決し、`.claude/worktrees/` または manifest の worker ルート配下なら
拒否（ask/hold）。symlink 構成要素は解決後に比較し、大小文字を区別しないファイルシステムでは同一性比較を大小文字非依存で行う。 A validator or scanner enumerates its inputs by walki
ng the filesystem under fixed roots (every regular file, ignored or untracked included), never by asking git which files exist: `git ls-files` trusts the index and the working-tree
 `.gitignore` rules, which a same-UID writer edits without a commit (a07 C-80 rounds 1 to 3, 2026-10-19); git is consulted only to confirm the root (`--show-toplevel` equality with
 a real `.git` directory) and never as an exclusion authority.
4. **検証したものを実行し、検証した内容を渡す** 検証した実行体はその realpath で実行する（再探索しない）。検証したファイル内容は信頼ルート配下のスナップショット（0600、一意名）とし
て渡し、使用直前に sha256 を再照合する。判断に読んだ証跡は sha256 を出力に記録する。
5. **出力と予約の同一性** 名前には 40 桁の head を使う（7 桁で衝突させない）。lock は信頼ルート配下の固定 inode に O_EXCL で作り、置換を inode 比較で検出する。物理スロット 1 つに l
ock 1 つ。
6. **正直な残余** 境界だけが緩和するリスクを `closed` と書かない。各文は残余を 1 行で明記する。
0. **脅威モデル（D-024-21）** 席は同じ OS ユーザで動き、ホストは席間の信頼境界ではない（同一 UID のプロセスは symlink 差し替え、共有 `.git` の object 差し替え、hook の子プロセス、H
erdr socket 経由の host 実行で、ホスト内のどの検査も迂回できる）。regime の硬い境界は GitHub（保護された main、必須チェック、orchestrator の identity によるマージ）。ただしこの境界
は **worker 席が orchestrator の GitHub 資格情報を共有しない**ときだけ成立する（D-024-22：worker 席は専用の GitHub identity（別アカウントまたは App のトークン）で `gh` に login し

ユーザでは資格情報は分離できない**（gh は keychain の項目を host/user で引き、同じ UID の gh は orchestrator のトークンを読める。`GH_CONFIG_DIR` は設定を分けるだけ）。防止には work
er 席を別の OS ユーザ（または別ホスト）で動かすしかなく、それは D-024-23 の将来項目（P1-16、操作者の判断）。それまで GitHub 境界は **検知**で守る：記録は boundary の記録 PR まで ma
in に無いので、検知は次の記録 PR の regime ジョブで行う（`.orchestration/acceptance/**` に触れる PR で、前回 boundary 以降の main の各マージ commit に、gate 通過の証跡を持つ受け入

止ではない」と書く。悪意ある worker に耐えるべき入力（承認台帳、gate が読む証跡 of record）は GitHub から sha 指定で API 経由（sandbox 内）に読み、ローカルファイルやローカル object

8. **承認はコミット済み台帳から読む** permission の決定行（`scope=permission approved_by=user diff_sha256=…`）は anchored checkout の作業コピーではなく、コミット済みの台帳から読む

ドレスで偽造できない）。作業コピーの行は提案で、記録 PR が main にマージされて初めて承認になる（PR の承認は操作者の操作）。偽造には main へのマージが要る。 The same applies to the

fork can hold the same commit (verdict a04 C-80 round 2, 2026-10-19). A mechanism whose application path runs code this contract does not yet cover (the agmsg storage layer sourced

erequisite is merged. The sha of canonical `main` comes from the fixed repository's API (`gh api repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha`), never from `git ls-rem

配下（`.agents/worklog/uv-cache`、gitignored、worker 書き込み不可）に固定し、`uv run --no-config --no-project --offline --python <信頼ルートの絶対パスのインタプリタ>` で起動する（`
--no-config` で uv の設定探索を止め、`--python` の絶対パスで cwd や親の `.venv` の発見を止める；敵対的な `.venv` と `uv.toml` を置いた fixture で検証）。hook は uv を使わず jq と p
ython 標準ライブラリだけで動く。 One trusted interpreter resolver (`scripts/orchestrator/trusted-interpreter.sh`, P1-3 lineage) resolves `<abs>` from the repository's pinned declar
ation to a regular file under the tool manager's install root (the install root is anchored to the passwd home of the real uid, never to the HOME variable, which a caller can forge
), refuses anything else, and every orchestrator-side script consumes it; no script keeps its own `command -v`, `mise which` or PATH fallback (ci-rerun.sh security review 44cb835, 
2026-10-19). Shell code of other projects (the agmsg storage layer and its `drivers.partition` sourcing) is never sourced by an orchestrator-side mechanism; counters are read from 
the agmsg SQLite store read-only with a fixed query or from the pasted record. Every Python child of a trusted entrypoint runs with `-I` (isolated: no user site, no `PYTHON*` envir
onment, no script directory on `sys.path`), so `uv run … python -I <script>` rather than `--script` for a script without declared dependencies; a test plants a `.pth` and a `usercu
stomize.py` in a fake user site and asserts they never execute (P1-15 amendment 5 C-80, 2026-10-19). A program takes `UV_CACHE_DIR` from the environment the trusted parent supplies
 and refuses when it is absent or not an absolute path; it never computes a default from its own root. The orchestrator's parent prefix sets the main checkout's `.agents/worklog/uv
-cache`; a worker's launcher sets `<worktree>/.uv-cache` (the P1-15 worker launch value: `.agents/` is read-only in the Codex permission profile, so a root-derived `.agents/worklog
/uv-cache` cannot be created by a worker; P1-12 a03, 2026-10-19T11:28Z); tests set a temporary directory.
10. **worker は sandbox 外でコマンドを実行しない（D-024-17 の改訂）** 2026-10-19T03:45Z の実測で `gh api` は Claude sandbox の中から成功した（sandbox の proxy は CONNECT 型で TLS 
を終端しない；keychain のトークンも読めた）。worker 席の除外コマンドは空にし、gh も git push も sandbox 内の proxy 経由で実行する。Codex 席は `sandbox_workspace_write.network_acces
s = true` で同じ状態にし、permgate の codex ポリシーは sandbox 外への escape を承認しない（permgate の変更は操作者の手順）。wrapper 方式（絶対パス、env -i、固定 GH_CONFIG_DIR）は L
D_PRELOAD と引数転送（`gh repo clone -- --config`）を閉じられないので採らない。

届かない。

def checker(root, data):
    """Return the base checker's violations on the base's dispatched bytes: it hands the text's literals to git (C8 to
    C10) and opens its design path (C6), so a pull request's own text never reaches it (worker review P0 of bcbd6949)."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
        cmd = [*CHECKER_RUN, "--root", root, str(Path(scratch, "task.md"))]
        Path(cmd[-1]).write_bytes(data)
        run = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    out = run.stdout.splitlines()  # the file is task.md, so C1 compares task_id with `task`; task-id checks <t>
    # only the checker's own verdict line with its exit code counts; a crash also exits 1, with no verdict line
    if (out[:1], run.returncode) not in ((["task.md: OK"], 0), (["task.md: FAIL"], 1)):
        return [("checker", f"no verdict (exit {run.returncode}): {(run.stdout + run.stderr).strip()[-300:]}")]
    lines = [ln.strip() for ln in out[1:] if ln.strip()]
    return [("checker", ln) for ln in lines if not re.fullmatch(r"C1 task_id .* != file task", ln)]


def check_task(root, base, head, t, changed, numstat):
    """Return (violations, warnings) for one task, each violation a (rule, detail) pair."""
    copy_path = f".orchestration/{t}/task.md"
    copy = show(root, head, copy_path)
    if (fm := front(copy)) is None:
        return [("front-matter", f"{copy_path} is unreadable or has no front matter mapping")], []
    data, rules, dispatched = policy(root, base, head, t)
    if rules is None:
        return [("front-matter", f"the base's .orchestration/tasks/{t}.md has no front matter mapping")], []
    found, warnings = [], []

Every `gh` invocation names the repository explicitly: `gh pr`, `gh run` and `gh issue` subcommands take `--repo mryfmo/dotfiles` or the full pull-request URL, and `gh api` (which has no `--repo` flag) takes the explicit `repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/…` endpoint path, never a `{owner}/{repo}` placeholder; a `gh api graphql` call binds the repository through fixed query variables (`owner: "mryfmo"`, `name: "dotfiles"` as constants in the script, passed with `-f`/`-F`) and uses only node ids obtained from a query bound by those variables (verdict a04 C-80 round 5, 2026-10-19): the local repository configuration selects the default repository otherwise, and a matching head sha does not bind the repository because a fork can hold the same commit (verdict a04 C-80 round 2, 2026-10-19). A mechanism whose application path runs code this contract does not yet cover (the agmsg storage layer sourced by `dispatch.sh`/`history.sh`; the integration gate until its own hardening task lands) names that task as the prerequisite of its `--apply` mode and runs shadow-only until the prerequisite is merged. The sha of canonical `main` comes from the fixed repository's API (`gh api repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha`), never from `git ls-remote origin`, whose destination the local remote and URL-rewrite configuration control (P1-12 a04 C-80, 2026-10-19T20:01Z); the content read at that sha comes from `repos/mryfmo/dotfiles/contents/<path>?ref=<sha40>`. Every `gh api` call that decides also binds the host with `--hostname github.com` (`GH_HOST` and the hosts configuration select the API host otherwise), a subcommand binds it through the `github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles` form of `--repo`, and a test that exports a hostile `GH_HOST` shows the call still names github.com or refuses (a02 review b2a186e, 2026-10-19T20:36Z).
9. **私設キャッシュ** orchestrator 側の実行は worker と共有するキャッシュ（`~/.cache/uv`、`~/.local/share/uv`、mise）から実行可能物を読まない。`UV_CACHE_DIR` を anchored checkout 配下（`.agents/worklog/uv-cache`、gitignored、worker 書き込み不可）に固定し、`uv run --no-config --no-project --offline --python <信頼ルートの絶対パスのインタプリタ>` で起動する（`--no-config` で uv の設定探索を止め、`--python` の絶対パスで cwd や親の `.venv` の発見を止める；敵対的な `.venv` と `uv.toml` を置いた fixture で検証）。hook は uv を使わず jq と python 標準ライブラリだけで動く。 One trusted interpreter resolver (`scripts/orchestrator/trusted-interpreter.sh`, P1-3 lineage) resolves `<abs>` from the repository's pinned declaration to a regular file under the tool manager's install root (the install root is anchored to the passwd home of the real uid, never to the HOME variable, which a caller can forge), refuses anything else, and every orchestrator-side script consumes it; no script keeps its own `command -v`, `mise which` or PATH fallback (ci-rerun.sh security review 44cb835, 2026-10-19). Shell code of other projects (the agmsg storage layer and its `drivers.partition` sourcing) is never sourced by an orchestrator-side mechanism; counters are read from the agmsg SQLite store read-only with a fixed query or from the pasted record. Every Python child of a trusted entrypoint runs with `-I` (isolated: no user site, no `PYTHON*` environment, no script directory on `sys.path`), so `uv run … python -I <script>` rather than `--script` for a script without declared dependencies; a test plants a `.pth` and a `usercustomize.py` in a fake user site and asserts they never execute (P1-15 amendment 5 C-80, 2026-10-19). A program takes `UV_CACHE_DIR` from the environment the trusted parent supplies and refuses when it is absent or not an absolute path; it never computes a default from its own root. The orchestrator's parent prefix sets the main checkout's `.agents/worklog/uv-cache`; a worker's launcher sets `<worktree>/.uv-cache` (the P1-15 worker launch value: `.agents/` is read-only in the Codex permission profile, so a root-derived `.agents/worklog/uv-cache` cannot be created by a worker; P1-12 a03, 2026-10-19T11:28Z); tests set a temporary directory.
10. **worker は sandbox 外でコマンドを実行しない（D-024-17 の改訂）** 2026-10-19T03:45Z の実測で `gh api` は Claude sandbox の中から成功した（sandbox の proxy は CONNECT 型で TLS を終端しない；keychain のトークンも読めた）。worker 席の除外コマンドは空にし、gh も git push も sandbox 内の proxy 経由で実行する。Codex 席は `sandbox_workspace_write.network_access = true` で同じ状態にし、permgate の codex ポリシーは sandbox 外への escape を承認しない（permgate の変更は操作者の手順）。wrapper 方式（絶対パス、env -i、固定 GH_CONFIG_DIR）は LD_PRELOAD と引数転送（`gh repo clone -- --config`）を閉じられないので採らない。
7. **検証** threat_table は本節の項目 1〜10 に 1 行ずつ対応させる（参照だけでは足りない）。共通テスト補助 `tests/unit/trusted_exec_contract.py`（P1-6 で作る）を使い、仕組みごとに 4 つの red→green テストを持つ：PATH 先頭の shim が実行されない、植え付けた GIT_* と git 設定が効かない、worker ルート配下の信頼パスが拒否される、検証後に差し替えたファイルが消費側に届かない。

def path_entry(root, value, fold=os.path.normcase):
    raw = root / value if isinstance(value, pathlib.Path) or normalise_name(value) else None
    found = confined(root, raw) if raw is not None else None

    if key and str(value).endswith(("/", "/.")):

    raw = pathlib.Path(path)
    path = raw.resolve()
